items.title: 輝達GTC大會即將登場 英特爾3大潛在受惠機會
items.title_en: NVIDIA GTC Conference Approaches, Three Potential Benefits for Intel
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 柏林 GTC 2026 大會本週登場，執行長黃仁勳預計於台灣時間週三 (21 日) 下午 5 點發表主題演講。科技媒體《Wccftech》分析指出，除了輝達自身的 AI 硬體布局，英特爾 (INTC-US) 能否在下一代產品中延續處理器合作，並進一步爭取晶圓代工與先進封裝訂單，也值得關注。
報導認為，若輝達釋出更多與英特爾合作的明確訊號，可能有助於改善市場對英特爾未來營收的預期。不過，涉及下一代 Feynman 架構的代工與封裝合作，目前仍屬市場傳聞，尚未獲得雙方正式確認。
柏林 GTC 工作坊於 10 月 20 日舉行，會議與展覽則安排在 21 至 22 日。黃仁勳的主題演講預定於柏林時間 21 日上午 11 點開始，換算台灣時間為當天下午 5 點。
處理器合作是英特爾最具實質基礎的受惠方向。
根據輝達官方規格，採用 Blackwell Ultra GPU 的 DGX B300，以及採用 Rubin GPU 的 DGX Rubin NVL8，均搭載英特爾 Xeon 6776P 處理器，其中 DGX Rubin NVL8 配置 2 顆 Xeon CPU。
這意味著，即使輝達持續擴大自研 CPU 布局，英特爾仍在部分 DGX 系統中扮演主機端處理器供應商的角色。
不過，既有產品採用 Xeon 已是公開資訊，柏林大會的觀察重點，在於這項合作是否延伸至後續產品世代。
輝達今年 3 月已揭露，下一代 Feynman 平台將納入自研 Rosa CPU。
《Wccftech》推測，部分 Feynman 架構 DGX 系統仍可能採用 Xeon，但這項配置目前尚未獲得官方確認。
晶圓代工則是另一項潛在機會。
市場傳聞指出，輝達可能採用英特爾 18A-P 或 14A 製程，製造 Feynman 世代的輸入／輸出 (I/O) 晶粒。若合作獲得證實，將有助於市場評估英特爾爭取外部代工客戶的進展，但目前製程選擇、訂單規模與生產時程均未明朗。
先進封裝方面，英特爾的 EMIB-T 與 Foveros 亦列為觀察方向，輝達未來是否可能採用其相關技術。
輝達今年持續推進 AI 平台布局，早在 3 月 16 日就已宣布，Vera Rubin 平台的 7 款晶片全面進入量產。此次柏林大會則讓市場有機會進一步了解其歐洲 AI 生態系與後續產品規劃。
對英特爾而言，這場活動的意義在於既有 CPU 合作能否延續，以及代工、封裝傳聞能否出現更具體的依據。至於英特爾能否比輝達本身獲得更大的市場效益，仍有待正式公告與實際訂單驗證。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) will hold its Berlin GTC 2026 conference this week, with CEO Jensen Huang scheduled to deliver a keynote at 5 p.m. Taiwan time on Wednesday (the 21st). Tech outlet Wccftech notes that beyond NVIDIA’s own AI hardware roadmap, it is worth watching whether Intel (INTC-US) can continue processor collaborations in next‑generation products and further win wafer‑fab and advanced‑packaging orders.

The report suggests that if NVIDIA signals more concrete cooperation with Intel, it could improve market expectations for Intel’s future revenue. However, any fab and packaging collaboration on the next‑gen Feynman architecture remains market rumor and has not been officially confirmed by either side.

The Berlin GTC workshops take place on October 20, with the conference and exhibition scheduled for the 21st‑22nd. Huang’s keynote is set to start at 11 a.m. Berlin time on the 21st, which is 5 p.m. Taiwan time that day.
Processor collaboration is the most tangible benefit avenue for Intel.

According to NVIDIA’s official specifications, the DGX B300 using the Blackwell Ultra GPU and the DGX Rubin NVL8 using the Rubin GPU both incorporate Intel Xeon 6776P processors, with the DGX Rubin NVL8 equipped with two Xeon CPUs.
This means that even as NVIDIA expands its own CPU designs, Intel still serves as the host‑side processor supplier for certain DGX systems.
However, the use of Xeon in existing products is already public; the key observation at the Berlin event is whether this cooperation will extend to future product generations.
NVIDIA disclosed in March that its next‑generation Feynman platform will include its own Rosa CPU.
Wccftech speculates that some Feynman‑based DGX systems may still use Xeon, but this configuration has not yet been officially confirmed.
Wafer fabrication represents another potential opportunity.

Market rumors indicate NVIDIA might use Intel’s 18A‑P or 14A process nodes to manufacture I/O chips for the Feynman generation. If confirmed, this would help assess Intel’s progress in winning external fab customers, though the chosen node, order size, and production timeline remain unclear.
On the advanced‑packaging front, Intel’s EMIB‑T and Foveros technologies are also being watched to see if NVIDIA may adopt them in the future.

NVIDIA continues to advance its AI platform rollout, having announced on March 16 that all seven chips of the Vera Rubin platform have entered volume production. The Berlin conference gives the market a chance to learn more about its European AI ecosystem and upcoming product plans.

For Intel, the event’s significance lies in whether existing CPU collaborations will continue and whether fab and packaging rumors will gain concrete footing. Whether Intel can capture greater market benefit than NVIDIA itself remains to be seen pending official announcements and actual orders.

items.title: AI暫時退位！能源股財報季有望領跑 獲利年增128%是科技業兩倍
items.title_en: AI Takes a Temporary Backseat! Energy Stocks Expected to Lead Earnings Season with 128% YoY Profit Growth, Double the Tech Sector
paras: 能源類股將於周二(20日)揭開財報季序幕，表現預料相當亮眼，根據FactSet彙整的最新預估，標普500指數能源類股第3季EPS預估年增128%，成長幅度約為科技業的兩倍。
不過，能源業獲利年增率可能不及第2季，當時國際油價平均每桶98美元，帶動能源企業獲利年增146%。第3季平均油價則小幅回落至每桶91美元。
儘管如此，從某些角度來看，第3季獲利仍能成長更令人意外。不久前多數分析師仍預期，伊朗戰爭將在夏季中間開始降溫，但如今戰事仍持續延燒，而且看不到明確的結束跡象。
巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，包括埃克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的多檔能源股，股價已來到或接近歷史高點，讓投資人對股價進一步上漲的期待也隨之提高。
目前能源企業面臨的最大問題是，打算如何運用豐沛的現金，以及是否會把握這次機會增加鑽探活動。

美國鑽井活動回溫 哈里伯頓獲利仍缺乏成長

油田服務公司哈里伯頓(Halliburton)(HAL-US)將於周二率先公布能源業財報，正好有機會滿足市場對鑽探活動的關注。
哈里伯頓是美國頁岩油產業規模最大的油田服務公司，而頁岩油占美國石油產量的最大比重。隨著美國石油生產商增加作業活動，鑽井平台數在多年下滑後終於再度回升，美國陸上鑽井平台數量今年已增加10%。
不過，油商活動仍須進一步大幅成長，才能真正帶動油田服務類股。市場預估，哈里伯頓EPS為58美分，與去年同期持平。
即使如此，哈里伯頓預估的零成長率仍優於同業。在能源產業所有次產業中，哈里伯頓所屬的油田設備與服務業是唯一預期平均EPS將年減的類別。

漲勢落後其他能源股 委內瑞拉業務成潛在利多

部分分析師認為，哈里伯頓等油田服務公司之所以值得關注，正是因為它們尚未跟上其他能源股的漲勢。
哈里伯頓也持續拓展海外業務，並已就向委內瑞拉提供服務達成初步協議。如果這些協議最終落實，可能成為推動股價開始大幅上漲的契機。
paras_en: Energy stocks will kick off the earnings season on Tuesday (the 20th), and performance is expected to be quite bright. According to the latest estimates compiled by FactSet, S&P 500 energy sector earnings per share for Q3 are projected to rise 128% year‑over‑year, roughly twice the growth rate of the technology sector.

However, the energy sector’s year‑over‑year profit growth may not match Q2, when the average international oil price was $98 per barrel, driving a 146% YoY profit increase for energy companies. In Q3 the average price slipped slightly to $91 per barrel.

Nevertheless, from some angles the Q3 profit growth remains surprisingly strong. Not long ago most analysts still expected the Iran war to start cooling in mid‑summer, but the conflict continues to flare up with no clear end in sight.
Barron’s reported that several energy stocks, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), have reached or are near historic highs, raising investors’ expectations for further price gains.
The biggest question facing energy companies now is how they will deploy abundant cash and whether they will seize this chance to boost drilling activity.

U.S. drilling activity is warming up, and Halliburton’s profit still lacks growth. Oilfield services firm Halliburton (HAL‑US) will be the first to report energy‑sector earnings on Tuesday, giving the market a chance to gauge drilling activity.

Halliburton is the largest oilfield services company in the U.S. shale oil industry, and shale oil accounts for the biggest share of U.S. oil production. As U.S. producers increase operations, the number of drilling rigs, which had been declining for years, is finally rising again, with on‑shore rigs up 10% so far this year.
Nevertheless, oil‑company activity still needs to grow substantially to truly lift oilfield‑services stocks. The market estimates Halliburton’s EPS at $0.58, flat with the same quarter last year.

Even so, Halliburton’s zero‑growth outlook is still better than its peers. Among all sub‑sectors in the energy industry, Halliburton’s oil‑field equipment and services segment is the only one expected to see an average EPS decline.

The stock’s rally lags behind other energy shares, and its Venezuela business could be a potential catalyst. Some analysts say Halliburton and other oilfield‑services firms are worth watching precisely because they have not kept pace with the gains of other energy stocks.

Halliburton continues to expand overseas and has reached a preliminary agreement to provide services in Venezuela. If those agreements are finalized, they could become the trigger for a sharp rise in the stock price.

items.title: 基隆市攜手中保科「智慧連線住警器3.0」 打造獨老居家安全防護網
items.title_en: Keelung City Partners with Zhongbao Technology to Launch “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0” for Elderly Living Alone Safety Network
paras: 為提升獨居長者居家安全，基隆市消防局攜手基隆市政府社會處與中保科技(9917-TW)，共同推動「獨老守望人身安全」專案，打造全台首創「智慧連線住警器3.0」服務，將智慧消防與AI科技導入獨居長者居家場域，從「即時偵測、遠端守護到緊急應變」，建立多層次安全防護機制，讓科技不只是偵測風險，更進一步串聯後端守護資源，提升長者居家生活的安全性與安心感。
基隆市副市長方定安表示，面對高齡化社會來臨，基隆市政府持續關注獨居長者的居家安全與生活照顧需求，除了透過既有社會福利與關懷服務提供支持，也積極導入智慧科技，讓科技成為守護長者安全的重要力量。基隆市本次推動「智慧連線住警器3.0」，透過即時偵測與連線通報機制，在火災等緊急狀況發生時，可以協助相關單位及早掌握狀況、迅速啟動應變，守護獨居長者居家安全。
本次基隆市消防局裝設全台首創的「智慧連線住警器3.0」，導入列冊獨居長者居家安全服務。相較於傳統火災警報設備，「智慧連線住警器3.0」除了能在現場即時發出警報，更可結合後端守護與通報機制，在火災發生時，爭取寶貴的應變時間。透過智慧科技強化獨居長者居家防災安全，也成為基隆市今年運用智慧科技推動獨老安全政策的重要亮點。
基隆市消防局局長游家懿指出，獨居長者的居家防火安全，一直是基隆市消防局關注的重要工作。獨居長者在面對火災等突發狀況時，可能因獨自在家而面臨較高的應變風險，因此消防安全除了強化「預防」與「警示」，也需要進一步建立即時通報與後端支援機制。基隆市消防局將持續結合智慧科技與消防專業，強化獨居長者居家安全防護，逐步建構從即時偵測、通報到應變的完整安全網，守護長者居家生活與市民的居住安全。
面對獨居長者及高齡家庭的居家照顧需求，除了居家安全與防災，中保科技更推出「中保無限+家庭守護服務」，導入AI智慧感知技術，結合24小時專業守護服務，從日常活動觀察、異常狀況提醒到緊急協助，打造兼顧安全、隱私與生活品質的智慧照顧方案。
中保科技智慧城市本部執行長周興國說，不同於傳統居家照顧設備多仰賴攝影機或單一感測方式，「中保無限+家庭守護服務」運用非影像式智慧感知技術，在不持續拍攝居家生活影像的情況下，透過AI分析長者日常活動樣態，協助掌握居家生活狀況。無論是活動異常、長時間未活動或有緊急需求，都能透過系統進行提醒，讓家人即使不在身邊，也能多一份安心，同時保有長者的生活隱私權。
中保科技進一步串接24小時守護中心，由專業團隊提供全天候遠端關懷服務。當系統偵測到異常狀況，守護中心可依情況進行關懷確認；若長者主動按下守護按鈕，也能即時啟動關懷機制，必要時協助聯繫家人及相關救援資源，讓智慧科技不只是「看得到數據」，更能在需要的時候提供實際協助，將AI智慧感知延伸為「科技結合人本」的完整家庭守護服務。
面對高齡化社會與獨居長者人數增加，未來居家安全將不再只是單一設備或單一單位的責任，而需要結合消防、科技、醫療照顧與社會支持等多方力量，共同建立更完整的安全防護網。透過科技設備與即時通報機制，讓消防安全從單一設備的警示，進一步延伸為更完整的居家安全網，守護市民居住安全。
此次基隆市消防局與基隆市政府社會處和中保科技合作，從「智慧消防」延伸至「智慧照顧」，透過科技強化獨居長者居家安全，也展現公私協力推動高齡友善與智慧城市的具體實踐。未來基隆市消防局將攜手中保科技，持續運用AI、物聯網及智慧感知等科技，串聯前端偵測與後端服務，讓科技不只是「看見危險」，更能在需要的時候即時伸出援手，打造長者安心、家人放心的居家生活。
台灣正式邁入超高齡社會，高齡長者的居家安全與照顧需求日益受到重視。依據基隆市政府民政處統計，截至今年8月底，基隆市總人口約35.8萬人，其中65歲以上長者約8.2萬人，占總人口約23%。
paras_en: To improve home safety for seniors living alone, Keelung City Fire Department teamed up with the city’s Social Affairs Office and Zhongbao Technology (9917‑TW) to launch the “Elderly Safety Watch” project, creating Taiwan’s first “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0” service. The system integrates smart fire protection and AI technology into the homes of seniors living alone, establishing a multi‑layered safety mechanism that moves from real‑time detection and remote monitoring to emergency response, turning technology from mere risk detection into a conduit for backend protective resources and enhancing both safety and peace of mind for older residents.

Keelung Deputy Mayor Fang Ding‑an said that as an aging society approaches, the city government continues to focus on the home safety and care needs of seniors living alone. In addition to existing welfare and care services, the city is actively introducing smart technology to make it a key force in protecting seniors. The “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0” uses real‑time detection and reporting, allowing relevant agencies to grasp situations early and launch rapid responses when fires or other emergencies occur, thereby safeguarding seniors living alone at home.

The Keelung Fire Department installed Taiwan’s first “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0,” adding it to the registry of home‑safety services for seniors living alone. Unlike traditional fire alarms, the new system not only issues an on‑site alert instantly but also links to backend protection and reporting mechanisms, buying precious response time when a fire breaks out. Strengthening disaster‑prevention safety for seniors living alone with smart technology has become a key highlight of Keelung’s elderly‑safety policy this year.

Fire Department Director You Jiayi noted that fire‑prevention safety for seniors living alone has always been a priority for the department. Because solitary seniors face higher response risks during sudden incidents such as fires, safety measures must go beyond prevention and warning to include real‑time reporting and backend support. The department will continue to combine smart technology with fire‑fighting expertise to reinforce home safety for seniors, gradually building a complete safety net from detection to reporting to response, protecting both seniors’ home life and residents’ overall safety.

To meet the home‑care needs of seniors living alone and aging families, Zhongbao Technology also launched the “Zhongbao Unlimited + Family Protection Service,” which incorporates AI‑driven smart perception technology and 24‑hour professional guardianship. The service monitors daily activities, alerts to abnormalities, and provides emergency assistance, delivering a smart care solution that balances safety, privacy, and quality of life.

Zhongbao’s Smart City division CEO Zhou Xingguo explained that unlike traditional home‑care devices that rely heavily on cameras or single sensors, the “Zhongbao Unlimited + Family Protection Service” uses non‑visual smart perception. Without continuous video recording, AI analyzes seniors’ daily activity patterns to gauge home conditions. Whether it detects unusual activity, prolonged inactivity, or urgent needs, the system sends alerts, giving families peace of mind even when they are away while preserving the seniors’ privacy rights.

The company further links a 24‑hour protection center staffed by professionals who provide round‑the‑clock remote care. When the system detects an anomaly, the center can verify the situation; if the senior presses the protection button, an immediate care protocol is triggered, and the center can help contact family members and rescue resources as needed. Thus, smart technology does more than “show data” – it offers tangible assistance when required, extending AI perception into a “technology‑plus‑human” comprehensive family protection service.

Facing an aging society and a growing number of seniors living alone, future home safety will no longer be the responsibility of a single device or agency. It will require collaboration among fire services, technology, medical care, and social support to build a more complete protective network. Through smart devices and real‑time reporting, fire safety evolves from a lone alarm to an integrated home‑safety net that safeguards residents’ living environment.

The collaboration among Keelung’s Fire Department, the city’s Social Affairs Office, and Zhongbao Technology extends “smart fire protection” into “smart care,” using technology to strengthen home safety for seniors living alone and demonstrating concrete public‑private cooperation toward an age‑friendly smart city. Going forward, the fire department will continue partnering with Zhongbao to leverage AI, IoT, and smart perception, linking front‑end detection with backend services so technology not only “sees danger” but also extends a helping hand in real time, creating a home environment that reassures seniors and their families.

Taiwan has officially entered a super‑aged society, and the home safety and care needs of older adults are receiving increasing attention. According to the Keelung City Civil Affairs Office, as of the end of August this year the city’s total population was about 358,000, with roughly 82,000 residents aged 65 and over, accounting for about 23% of the total population.

items.title: 受油輪遇襲影響 亞洲液化天然氣價格飆至近4年新高
items.title_en: Asian LNG Prices Surge to Near Four-Year High Amid Oil Tanker Attacks
paras: 受中東油氣船隻頻遭襲擊影響，亞洲液化天然氣(LNG)現貨價格周一飆升至每百萬英熱單位(MMBtu)30.4美元，創下自2022年12月以來，接近4年的新高。
英國海事貿易行動辦公室周末接獲報告，一艘LNG運載船於周六在葉門附近遭到襲擊，顯示紅海與荷姆茲海峽一帶對油氣船隻的攻擊持續升溫。同時，美伊戰爭導致以往占全球供應量約五分之一的卡達LNG產量被困於荷姆茲海峽後方。
由於無法獲得足夠的合約交貨量，買家被迫轉向昂貴的現貨市場，加上北半球冬季臨近帶動需求增加，價格已暴漲至今年2月下旬衝突爆發前水準的三倍。部分亞洲買家持續以高價搶購現貨，加劇了與歐洲對超冷燃料的競爭。目前歐洲天然氣儲藏量僅達75%，低於5年同期平均的89%。
這場能源危機已推升家庭電費與通膨壓力，並迫使部分經濟體轉向依賴煤炭。南韓能源部長上周表示，他們將仰賴煤炭與核能，以因應冬季用電高峰的激增需求。
paras_en: Asian spot LNG prices jumped on Monday to $30.4 per million British thermal units (MMBtu), the highest level in almost four years, the most since December 2022, as Middle‑East oil and gas vessels continue to be attacked.

The UK Maritime Trade Action Office received a report over the weekend that an LNG carrier was attacked near Yemen on Saturday, indicating that attacks on oil and gas ships in the Red Sea and the Hormuz Strait are heating up. At the same time, the US‑Iran conflict has left Qatar’s LNG output – normally about one‑fifth of global supply – stranded behind the Hormuz Strait.

Because contract deliveries are insufficient, buyers have been forced into the pricey spot market, and with the northern‑hemisphere winter approaching, demand has surged, pushing prices to three times the level seen before the conflict erupted in late February. Some Asian buyers keep snapping up spot cargoes at high prices, intensifying competition with Europe for ultra‑cold fuel. Europe’s gas storage is now only at 75% of capacity, below the five‑year average of 89%.

The energy crunch has lifted household electricity bills and inflation pressure, prompting some economies to lean on coal. South Korea’s energy minister said last week that the country will rely on coal and nuclear power to meet the surge in electricity demand during the winter peak.

paras: 一、盤勢結構與技術面：量縮拉回，短線仍待止穩

台股今日呈現「量縮震盪拉回整理」格局，終場下跌 529點，收在46,292點，成交值萎縮至約 7,625億元，顯示市場追價意願不足，短線仍受國際利空與籌碼調節壓抑。
技術面方面，短線須觀察指數能否在前波低點附近獲得支撐，尤其 8月25日止跌紅K棒區間44,210～45,169點，可列為重要參考支撐區，但仍須搭配量價及買盤變化確認。
上檔則須留意 10日線與月線能否重新站回。若量能回溫、指數突破均線反壓，才有機會確認反彈力道增強。


二、影響盤勢因素：國際利空未除，市場信心仍待修復

美國通膨黏性高於預期，增添利率政策不確定性；AI投資報酬與獲利變現疑慮尚未完全消除，加上中國長鑫存儲擴產帶來產業競爭壓力，使科技股評價面臨考驗。
融資餘額居高不下，外資與自營商持續調節，反映市場籌碼仍待沉澱。短線即使出現反彈，也須提防解套賣壓與反彈不連續的風險。
後續觀察重點包括新台幣能否止貶回升、外資期現貨賣壓是否收斂、費半指數能否止跌，以及國際AI龍頭釋出的產業訊息。


三、籌碼與資金面：外資賣壓沉重，ETF與政策資金提供支撐

外資今日賣超約 795.4億元，今年以來累計賣超達 2.11兆元，顯示外資態度仍偏保守；惟後續若國際環境改善、匯率趨穩，不排除出現回補行情，但仍須觀察實際買盤。
依據原文資料，台股ETF今年平均每月淨流入約1,300億元，投信前九月累計買超約7,800億元，顯示內資仍具一定承接能力。
國家隊與ETF資金可望在市場回檔時提供支撐，但不代表指數不會進一步修正，仍應以成交量、法人動向及關鍵價位作為判斷依據。


四、中長期基本面：出口與企業獲利成長，AI仍是重要支柱

台灣9月出口達 872.2億美元，年增60.9%，連續35個月正成長，反映AI、高效能運算及電子供應鏈需求仍具韌性。
展望第四季，Vera Rubin平台、Google TPU等新世代AI晶片逐步推進，將帶動先進製程、ASIC、CoWoS、PCB、伺服器、液冷散熱、電源管理及光通訊等供應鏈需求。
原文引用的市場預估指出，2026年台股企業獲利年增率可達53%，2027年與2028年仍有約24%及23%的成長空間。惟上述為預估值，後續仍須留意企業財報、資本支出與AI投資效益是否符合預期。


五、產業與個股：聚焦AI供應鏈，留意低基期與相對抗跌族群

CPO與矽光子： AI晶片運算能力提升，帶動高速互連與光通訊需求，CPO有望成為長期技術發展方向，但仍須追蹤商業化進度及實際訂單。
AI硬體與高階材料： ASIC、PCB／CCL、玻纖布、先進封裝、被動元件及高階耗材，仍是市場關注主軸。
相對強勢觀察名單： 玻纖布建榮(5340-TW)、德宏(5475-TW)、富喬(1815-TW)；軟板台郡(6269-TW)、律勝(3354-TW)；散熱力致(3483-TW)；觸控GIS-KY(6456-TW)；資服智聯服(6751-TW)；光學鏡頭聯一光(3441-TW)、今國光(6209-TW)；電子零件暨設備好德(3114-TW)、以及部分低基期轉機股等。
輝達10月20日至22日在柏林舉行GTC大會，市場可留意AI基礎建設、主權AI及機器人等相關訊息。不過，題材不等於獲利，個股仍須檢視營收、訂單、估值與籌碼。


六、後市展望與操作策略：汰弱留強、分批布局，不追漲殺跌

短線： 國際利空與法人賣壓尚未解除，指數仍可能震盪探底，不宜因單日反彈就認定落底，也不宜因下跌而恐慌殺出。
中長線： AI產業趨勢與台灣出口基本面仍具支撐，若指數逐步止穩、外資賣壓收斂，且重新站回10日線及月線，可再觀察反彈延續性。
選股策略： 反彈汰弱留強，優先挑選基本面明確、訂單能見度高、流動性佳且股價相對抗跌的優質標的；低基期轉機股則須確認營運改善，避免單純追逐題材。
風險控管： 採分批布局、保留現金、設定停損與持股比重上限，避免融資重押或盲目接刀。


總結
台股目前處於「短線籌碼修正、中長期基本面仍具支撐」的關鍵階段。真正值得掌握的，不是猜測指數何時最低，而是等待賣壓收斂、技術面止穩，再從AI供應鏈中挑選具備實質獲利成長與資金關注的標的。

items.title: 金管會：全台逾1.2萬人約定防詐「指定聯絡人」 玉山、北富銀推廣最積極
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission: Over 12,200 Taiwanese Have Designated Anti‑Fraud Contacts; E.Sun and Taipei Fubon Lead Promotion
paras: 為守護國人財產安全，金管會積極推動「大額匯款或定存解約通知指定聯絡人」防詐服務。截至今(2026)年7月底止，已有 12,580 位民眾完成申辦；截至9月底，全台已有 24 家銀行開辦此項服務，另有 7 家本國銀行及中華郵政公司預計於明(2027)年 6 月底前陸續上線。在各家金融機構中，玉山銀行與台北富邦銀行表現最為突出，積極落實關懷與推廣機制，獲得金管會特別點名表揚。
根據金管會統計，截至 7 月底，申辦件數前二大的銀行皆展現強大的防詐推廣力道，玉山銀行以 7,542 件居全台之冠，推廣成效卓著；台北富邦銀行以 3,426 件位居第二，表現同樣相當亮眼；聯邦銀行則以 986 件 排名第三。
銀行局副局長王允中會中特別分享成功的攔阻案例，日前有一名客戶至玉山銀行分行欲辦理匯款，並稱該筆款項為「房屋裝潢費」。行員警覺性極高，查閱資料後發現客戶先前已申辦「指定聯絡人」服務，便第一時間聯繫其妻。妻子獲報趕到現場後表示，兩人雖曾討論過裝潢，但絕未到匯款階段，當場極力阻止。事後證實，該名客戶確實遭遇詐騙，成功保住高達 30 萬元的積蓄。
王允中指出，該服務採「自由申請、自主指定」原則，民眾可預先註記信任的親友(如配偶、子女、教授等)為聯絡人，且能隨時彈性變更。當發生定存解約或轉匯超過一定金額(門檻由各銀行與客戶個別約定)時，銀行將第一時間通知指定聯絡人。
他強調，此服務完全免費，不僅能維持客戶財務隱私與交易自主權，更能透過親友及時的關懷與查證，降低民眾獨自做出重大財務決定而被騙的風險，讓防詐工作從「事後追查」跨越至「事前預防、即時辨識與及早攔阻」。
除銀行業外，金管會保險局亦積極鼓勵壽險業者推動保單指定聯絡人機制(如辦理保單借款或解約時通知)。截至今年 8 月 10 日止，壽險業申辦人數已達 38,225 人，前三大業者分別為富邦人壽(13,238人)、南山人壽(7,737人)及國泰人壽(7,267人)。至於投信事業之基金贖回業務，證期局表示目前尚無類似指定聯絡人之機制。
金管會強調，防詐不能單靠單一機制，呼籲民眾多與家人討論防詐觀念，特別是家中長輩或較少接觸金融服務者，可主動向往來銀行洽詢並完成約定，共同建立防護網。金管會每年亦會舉辦打詐頒獎機制，公開表揚積極攔阻詐騙的金融機構，鼓勵各界持續推動防詐作為。
paras_en: To protect citizens' financial safety, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) has been actively promoting an anti‑fraud service that notifies a designated contact person for large remittances or time‑deposit cancellations. By the end of July 2026, 12,580 people had completed the registration; by the end of September, 24 banks nationwide were offering the service, with another seven domestic banks and Chunghwa Post slated to launch it by the end of June 2027. Among the institutions, E.Sun Bank and Taipei Fubon Bank stood out for their proactive care and promotion, earning special commendation from the FSC.

According to FSC data, as of the end of July the two banks with the highest number of registrations demonstrated strong anti‑fraud outreach. E.Sun Bank led the nation with 7,542 registrations, showing remarkable promotion results; Taipei Fubon Bank ranked second with 3,426 registrations, also a striking performance; and Union Bank placed third with 986 registrations.

Deputy Director‑General Wang Yunchung of the Banking Bureau shared a successful interception case at a recent forum. A customer visited an E.Sun branch to make a remittance, claiming the funds were for “home renovation.” The teller, highly alert, checked the customer’s records and found that the customer had previously enrolled in the designated‑contact service, so the teller immediately contacted the customer’s spouse. The spouse arrived on the scene and said that, although they had discussed renovation, no remittance had been approved, and she stopped the transaction. It was later confirmed that the customer was indeed targeted by a scam, and the service helped protect savings of up to NT$300,000.

Wang explained that the service operates on a “voluntary application, self‑designated” principle. Individuals can pre‑record trusted relatives or friends (such as a spouse, child, or professor) as contacts and can change them at any time. When a time‑deposit is terminated or a transfer exceeds a certain amount (the threshold is set individually by each bank and customer), the bank promptly notifies the designated contact.

He emphasized that the service is completely free, preserving customers’ financial privacy and transaction autonomy while allowing timely care and verification from trusted contacts. This reduces the risk of individuals being scammed when making major financial decisions alone, shifting anti‑fraud work from “post‑incident investigation” to “pre‑emptive prevention, real‑time identification and early interception.”

Beyond banking, the FSC’s Insurance Bureau is also encouraging life‑insurance companies to adopt a designated‑contact mechanism for policy loans or cancellations. As of August 10 this year, 38,225 people had signed up, with the top three providers being Fubon Life (13,238), Nan Shan Life (7,737) and Cathay Life (7,267). For mutual‑fund redemptions, the Securities and Futures Bureau noted that no similar designated‑contact system currently exists.

The FSC stressed that anti‑fraud efforts cannot rely on a single mechanism, urging the public to discuss fraud‑prevention concepts with family members, especially seniors or those less familiar with financial services, and to proactively inquire with their banks about enrolling in the program to build a shared protection network. The FSC also holds an annual anti‑fraud award ceremony to publicly recognize financial institutions that actively block scams, encouraging continued industry‑wide anti‑fraud initiatives.

此前受中東局勢、油價上揚及總理高市早苗財政政策疑慮影響，超長期日債殖利率曾攀至數十年高點，如今高殖利率正顯著吸引國內外資金回流。
根據日本證券業協會統計，今年上半財政年度(4 月至 9 月)，主要國內投資人買超日本國債金額達 18.755 兆日元，創下 2009 年度以來同期新高。其中，代表公的年金基金的信託銀行占近一半，商業銀行約占三分之一。
三菱日聯摩根士丹利證券資深債券策略師鶴田啓介表示，信託銀行買盤主因上半財年股市走高與日元走貶，觸發了「由股轉債」的資產配置再平衡。至於銀行賣超外債並買進日債，鶴田認為主因高油價推升美歐債殖利率，銀行為避開外債衝擊而拋售，對日債則屬消極配置以維持利差收入。
道富投資管理東京資深固定收益策略師Masahiko Loo指出，高殖利率讓「日債重新具備投資價值」，市場心態已從「不接掉下來的刀子」轉變為「領息等待」。富國生命保險表示，由於殖利率升幅超乎預期，正研擬將資金從外債轉回日債。
法巴資產管理資深債券策略師木村龍太郎認為，標售結果反映國內需求復甦。本次有超過 83% 投標來自未公開買家，顯示大型銀行與政府年金投資基金(GPIF)積極參與；不過他也提醒，若股市下跌限制年金再平衡，或銀行趁機獲利了結，殖利率大幅下行空間有限。
市場目前正密切留意下周日本央行政策會議，關注總裁植田和男對未來緊縮步調的最新訊號。
paras_en: Japan's Ministry of Finance held a 20-year government bond auction on Tuesday (the 20th) that attracted record-strong demand. After the results were announced, the 20-year Japanese bond yield briefly fell 6 basis points to 3.710%, while the 30-year yield slipped about 5 basis points.
The bid‑to‑cover ratio this time reached 5.84 times, far above the previous 4.01 times and the 12‑month average of 3.73 times.

Earlier, amid Middle‑East tensions, rising oil prices and doubts over Prime Minister Kishida's fiscal policy, ultra‑long‑term Japanese bond yields had climbed to multi‑decade highs. Now the high yields are clearly drawing domestic and foreign capital back.

According to data from the Japan Securities Dealers Association, domestic investors bought a net 18.755 trillion yen of Japanese government bonds in the first half of the fiscal year (April‑September), a record high for the same period since 2009. Trust banks representing public pension funds accounted for almost half of the purchases, with commercial banks about one‑third.

Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities senior bond strategist Keisuke Tsuruta said trust‑bank buying was driven by a strong equity market and a weakening yen in the first half of the fiscal year, prompting a “stock‑to‑bond” asset‑allocation rebalance. As for banks selling foreign bonds and buying JGBs, Tsuruta believes high oil prices have pushed up U.S. and European bond yields, leading banks to shed foreign‑bond exposure and take a passive stance on JGBs to preserve spread income.

State Street Global Advisors Tokyo senior fixed‑income strategist Masahiko Loo noted that the high yields have restored “investment value” to Japanese bonds, shifting market sentiment from “avoiding a falling knife” to “collecting coupons while waiting.” Fubon Life Insurance said the unexpected yield rise is prompting it to consider moving funds from foreign bonds back into JGBs.

BNP Paribas Asset Management senior bond strategist Ryutaro Kimura said the auction results reflect a revival of domestic demand. More than 83% of bids came from non‑public investors, showing active participation by large banks and the Government Pension Investment Fund (GPIF). He cautioned, however, that a stock‑market decline limiting pension rebalancing or banks taking profit could restrict how far yields can fall further.
The market is now closely watching next week’s Bank of Japan policy meeting for any new signals from Governor Kazuo Ueda on the pace of future monetary tightening.

items.title: 「當然可能」！Jordi Visser：比特幣市值有望漲至50兆美元　「這件事」是否實現為關鍵
items.title_en: "Certainly Possible"! Jordi Visser: Bitcoin Market Cap Could Rise to $50 Trillion – Whether "This Happens" Is the Key
paras: 資深宏觀投資人暨VisserLabs創辦人Jordi Visser最新表示，隨著避險基金解除槓桿，比特幣正悄然跑贏所有主要資產類別，估值最終有望達到50兆美元！
Visser上週六(18日)在Anthony Pompliano的播客中表示，近期與AI股票相關的市場拋售，與AI本身的失敗毫無關係，並將其比作1998年長期資本管理公司(Long-Term Capital Management)的倒閉，並主張真正的壓力源來自「槓桿避險基金」，而非AI的建設浪潮。
Visser以Lone Pine Capital為例指出，截至9月漲幅曾超過40%，但隨後回吐全部收益。在Visser看來，這證明了基金運用槓桿的方式正出現結構性崩潰，而非AI增長故事存在任何缺陷。
Visser也反對將AI基礎設施公司與網路泡沫時代相提並論。他表示，CoreWeave與那個時代有根本上的不同，因其收入來自微軟、Meta和OpenAI，而非投機性的電信債務。
Visser認為，即便短期內個股估值過高，AI最終獲利仍不可避免，因為運算需求持續超過供應。
Visser指出，在標普500和那斯達克持平、債券下跌的過去四個月，比特幣一直在8.2萬至8.5萬美元之間交易。他還表示，隨著資本逃離風險較高、槓桿化的交易，比特幣正充當「安全的落腳點」。他認為，這種表現為「良好的夏普比率(Sharpe ratio)」行為，之所以突出是因為目前極少有其他資產能產生乾淨的回報。
當被問及比特幣是否可能現實地達到50兆美元的估值，Visser回答「當然可能」。他指向全球約900兆美元、目前大多缺乏流動性的資產，並表示代幣化(tokenization)最終可能將這些資產解鎖為流動、可交易的形式。
Visser主張，相同邏輯也適用於比特幣，正如馬斯克曾對SpaceX提出的論點：隨著更大規模的資金變得流動，單一資產的價值也能隨之擴展。
Visser預估，AI股票和比特幣下一波主要漲勢將出現在兩個特定時間窗口：一是本月稍晚「超大規模雲端企業(hyperscaler)」財報公布後；二是12月時許多基金將在年底停止承擔風險。
他指出，摩根士丹利機構經紀部門的AI多空部位已降至過去一年第7百分位，這表明該交易中的大部分槓桿風險已經被撤出。
Visser完全淡化9月高於預期的CPI數據，認為只要通膨讀數介於2%至3.5%之間，除非伴隨實際的就業崗位(他強調就業損失仍接近歷史低點)，否則對市場影響不大。
paras_en: Senior macro investor and VisserLabs founder Jordi Visser said that as hedge‑funds unwind leverage, Bitcoin is quietly out‑performing all major asset classes and its valuation could eventually reach $50 trillion.

Visser told Anthony Pompliano’s podcast on Saturday (the 18th) that the recent market sell‑off in AI‑related stocks has nothing to do with AI’s failure, likening it to the 1998 collapse of Long‑Term Capital Management and arguing that the real pressure comes from leveraged hedge funds, not the AI construction wave.

Citing Lone Pine Capital as an example, Visser noted that its gains had topped 40% by September before giving back all of the profit, which he says proves that the way funds use leverage is undergoing a structural breakdown rather than any flaw in the AI growth story.

Visser also rejected comparisons between AI infrastructure firms and the dot‑com bubble, saying CoreWeave is fundamentally different because its revenue comes from Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI rather than speculative telecom debt.
He believes that even if individual AI stocks are over‑valued in the short term, AI profits are inevitable because computing demand continues to outstrip supply.

Visser pointed out that over the past four months, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq have been flat and bonds have fallen, Bitcoin has traded between $82,000 and $85,000, and as capital flees higher‑risk, leveraged trades, Bitcoin is acting as a "safe landing spot"—a behavior he calls a "good Sharpe ratio" because few other assets are delivering clean returns right now.

When asked whether Bitcoin could realistically hit a $50 trillion valuation, Visser answered “certainly possible,” pointing to roughly $900 trillion of global assets that are largely illiquid and saying tokenization could eventually unlock those assets into liquid, tradable forms.
Visser argued the same logic applies to Bitcoin, echoing a point Musk made about SpaceX: as larger pools of capital become liquid, the value of a single asset can expand accordingly.

Visser forecasts the next major rally for AI stocks and Bitcoin will occur in two specific windows: later this month after the earnings of the “hyperscale” cloud giants, and in December when many funds will stop taking risk at year‑end.
He noted that Morgan Stanley’s institutional brokerage AI long‑short position has fallen to the 7th percentile of the past year, indicating that most leveraged risk in that trade has been withdrawn.

Visser downplayed September’s higher‑than‑expected CPI reading, saying that as long as inflation stays between 2% and 3.5% and isn’t accompanied by a real‑job loss (he stressed job losses remain near historic lows), its market impact will be limited.

items.title: 基隆市攜手中保科「智慧連線住警器3.0」 打造獨老居家安全防護網
items.title_en: Keelung City Partners with Zhongbao Technology to Launch “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0” for Elderly Living Alone Safety Network
paras: 為提升獨居長者居家安全，基隆市消防局攜手基隆市政府社會處與中保科技(9917-TW)，共同推動「獨老守望人身安全」專案，打造全台首創「智慧連線住警器3.0」服務，將智慧消防與AI科技導入獨居長者居家場域，從「即時偵測、遠端守護到緊急應變」，建立多層次安全防護機制，讓科技不只是偵測風險，更進一步串聯後端守護資源，提升長者居家生活的安全性與安心感。
基隆市副市長方定安表示，面對高齡化社會來臨，基隆市政府持續關注獨居長者的居家安全與生活照顧需求，除了透過既有社會福利與關懷服務提供支持，也積極導入智慧科技，讓科技成為守護長者安全的重要力量。基隆市本次推動「智慧連線住警器3.0」，透過即時偵測與連線通報機制，在火災等緊急狀況發生時，可以協助相關單位及早掌握狀況、迅速啟動應變，守護獨居長者居家安全。
本次基隆市消防局裝設全台首創的「智慧連線住警器3.0」，導入列冊獨居長者居家安全服務。相較於傳統火災警報設備，「智慧連線住警器3.0」除了能在現場即時發出警報，更可結合後端守護與通報機制，在火災發生時，爭取寶貴的應變時間。透過智慧科技強化獨居長者居家防災安全，也成為基隆市今年運用智慧科技推動獨老安全政策的重要亮點。
基隆市消防局局長游家懿指出，獨居長者的居家防火安全，一直是基隆市消防局關注的重要工作。獨居長者在面對火災等突發狀況時，可能因獨自在家而面臨較高的應變風險，因此消防安全除了強化「預防」與「警示」，也需要進一步建立即時通報與後端支援機制。基隆市消防局將持續結合智慧科技與消防專業，強化獨居長者居家安全防護，逐步建構從即時偵測、通報到應變的完整安全網，守護長者居家生活與市民的居住安全。
面對獨居長者及高齡家庭的居家照顧需求，除了居家安全與防災，中保科技更推出「中保無限+家庭守護服務」，導入AI智慧感知技術，結合24小時專業守護服務，從日常活動觀察、異常狀況提醒到緊急協助，打造兼顧安全、隱私與生活品質的智慧照顧方案。
中保科技智慧城市本部執行長周興國說，不同於傳統居家照顧設備多仰賴攝影機或單一感測方式，「中保無限+家庭守護服務」運用非影像式智慧感知技術，在不持續拍攝居家生活影像的情況下，透過AI分析長者日常活動樣態，協助掌握居家生活狀況。無論是活動異常、長時間未活動或有緊急需求，都能透過系統進行提醒，讓家人即使不在身邊，也能多一份安心，同時保有長者的生活隱私權。
中保科技進一步串接24小時守護中心，由專業團隊提供全天候遠端關懷服務。當系統偵測到異常狀況，守護中心可依情況進行關懷確認；若長者主動按下守護按鈕，也能即時啟動關懷機制，必要時協助聯繫家人及相關救援資源，讓智慧科技不只是「看得到數據」，更能在需要的時候提供實際協助，將AI智慧感知延伸為「科技結合人本」的完整家庭守護服務。
面對高齡化社會與獨居長者人數增加，未來居家安全將不再只是單一設備或單一單位的責任，而需要結合消防、科技、醫療照顧與社會支持等多方力量，共同建立更完整的安全防護網。透過科技設備與即時通報機制，讓消防安全從單一設備的警示，進一步延伸為更完整的居家安全網，守護市民居住安全。
此次基隆市消防局與基隆市政府社會處和中保科技合作，從「智慧消防」延伸至「智慧照顧」，透過科技強化獨居長者居家安全，也展現公私協力推動高齡友善與智慧城市的具體實踐。未來基隆市消防局將攜手中保科技，持續運用AI、物聯網及智慧感知等科技，串聯前端偵測與後端服務，讓科技不只是「看見危險」，更能在需要的時候即時伸出援手，打造長者安心、家人放心的居家生活。
台灣正式邁入超高齡社會，高齡長者的居家安全與照顧需求日益受到重視。依據基隆市政府民政處統計，截至今年8月底，基隆市總人口約35.8萬人，其中65歲以上長者約8.2萬人，占總人口約23%。
paras_en: To improve home safety for seniors living alone, Keelung City Fire Department teamed up with the city’s Social Affairs Office and Zhongbao Technology (9917‑TW) to launch the “Elderly Safety Watch” project, creating Taiwan’s first “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0” service. The system integrates smart fire protection and AI technology into the homes of seniors living alone, establishing a multi‑layered safety mechanism that moves from real‑time detection and remote monitoring to emergency response, turning technology from mere risk detection into a conduit for backend protective resources and enhancing both safety and peace of mind for older residents.

Keelung Deputy Mayor Fang Ding‑an said that as an aging society approaches, the city government continues to focus on the home safety and care needs of seniors living alone. In addition to existing welfare and care services, the city is actively introducing smart technology to make it a key force in protecting seniors. The “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0” uses real‑time detection and reporting, allowing relevant agencies to grasp situations early and launch rapid responses when fires or other emergencies occur, thereby safeguarding seniors living alone at home.

The Keelung Fire Department installed Taiwan’s first “Smart Connected Home Alarm 3.0,” adding it to the registry of home‑safety services for seniors living alone. Unlike traditional fire alarms, the new system not only issues an on‑site alert instantly but also links to backend protection and reporting mechanisms, buying precious response time when a fire breaks out. Strengthening disaster‑prevention safety for seniors living alone with smart technology has become a key highlight of Keelung’s elderly‑safety policy this year.

Fire Department Director You Jiayi noted that fire‑prevention safety for seniors living alone has always been a priority for the department. Because solitary seniors face higher response risks during sudden incidents such as fires, safety measures must go beyond prevention and warning to include real‑time reporting and backend support. The department will continue to combine smart technology with fire‑fighting expertise to reinforce home safety for seniors, gradually building a complete safety net from detection to reporting to response, protecting both seniors’ home life and residents’ overall safety.

To meet the home‑care needs of seniors living alone and aging families, Zhongbao Technology also launched the “Zhongbao Unlimited + Family Protection Service,” which incorporates AI‑driven smart perception technology and 24‑hour professional guardianship. The service monitors daily activities, alerts to abnormalities, and provides emergency assistance, delivering a smart care solution that balances safety, privacy, and quality of life.

Zhongbao’s Smart City division CEO Zhou Xingguo explained that unlike traditional home‑care devices that rely heavily on cameras or single sensors, the “Zhongbao Unlimited + Family Protection Service” uses non‑visual smart perception. Without continuous video recording, AI analyzes seniors’ daily activity patterns to gauge home conditions. Whether it detects unusual activity, prolonged inactivity, or urgent needs, the system sends alerts, giving families peace of mind even when they are away while preserving the seniors’ privacy rights.

The company further links a 24‑hour protection center staffed by professionals who provide round‑the‑clock remote care. When the system detects an anomaly, the center can verify the situation; if the senior presses the protection button, an immediate care protocol is triggered, and the center can help contact family members and rescue resources as needed. Thus, smart technology does more than “show data” – it offers tangible assistance when required, extending AI perception into a “technology‑plus‑human” comprehensive family protection service.

Facing an aging society and a growing number of seniors living alone, future home safety will no longer be the responsibility of a single device or agency. It will require collaboration among fire services, technology, medical care, and social support to build a more complete protective network. Through smart devices and real‑time reporting, fire safety evolves from a lone alarm to an integrated home‑safety net that safeguards residents’ living environment.

The collaboration among Keelung’s Fire Department, the city’s Social Affairs Office, and Zhongbao Technology extends “smart fire protection” into “smart care,” using technology to strengthen home safety for seniors living alone and demonstrating concrete public‑private cooperation toward an age‑friendly smart city. Going forward, the fire department will continue partnering with Zhongbao to leverage AI, IoT, and smart perception, linking front‑end detection with backend services so technology not only “sees danger” but also extends a helping hand in real time, creating a home environment that reassures seniors and their families.

Taiwan has officially entered a super‑aged society, and the home safety and care needs of older adults are receiving increasing attention. According to the Keelung City Civil Affairs Office, as of the end of August this year the city’s total population was about 358,000, with roughly 82,000 residents aged 65 and over, accounting for about 23% of the total population.

items.title: 欣興(3037)直擊AI高階HDI與光模組布局！60層板已有樣品，NPO成下一代技術焦點
items.title_en: Xinxing (3037) Targets AI High-End HDI and Optical Module Layouts! 60-Layer Board Sample Ready, NPO Becomes Focus of Next-Gen Technology
paras: 2026年10月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 優分析團隊前往2026年台灣電路板產業國際展覽會(TPCA Show)，實際訪問欣興(3037)，了解AI伺服器高階PCB與光通訊布局。
欣興正將資源集中於AI伺服器、交換器及高階HDI產品，HDI已具備60層樣品；光通訊則從800G逐步邁向1.6T，並持續關注NPO、CPO等下一代光學架構。

AI伺服器板朝高階HDI發展，欣興60層樣品已到位
受訪者指出，AI伺服器與交換器用板層數已來到30至40層，部分板材重量達6至7公斤，對設備傳輸、製程能力與線寬線距提出更高要求。
公司目前聚焦compute tray、switch tray及networking tray等產品，HDI最高已有60層樣品。
隨著高階材料從M8朝M9演進，材料成本與設備投資也將同步增加，但新世代材料與製程的導入速度，仍取決於客戶設計及投資時程。

光模組從800G邁向1.6T，NPO瞄準功耗與散熱瓶頸
光通訊方面，受訪者表示，800G已於2025年至2026年上半年進入量產階段，接下來的發展重點轉向1.6T，並持續評估NPO、CPO等架構。
現階段可插拔光模組仍是主流，但隨傳輸速率提高，DSP功耗與交換器散熱壓力也更加突出。
以1.6T光模組為例，DSP功耗約25瓦；若交換器配置多個光模組，整體熱管理將成為重要挑戰。
NPO的方向是讓光模組更靠近交換器ASIC，縮短訊號傳輸距離，並降低DSP的規格與功耗需求；CPO則進一步將光學元件與ASIC整合。
受訪者認為，下一代架構仍在研發與評估階段，NPO是目前值得關注的方向。
欣興能否憑藉高階HDI能力與AI客戶合作經驗，掌握新一代光通訊架構需求，將是後續觀察重點。

paras_en: On October 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The U-Analysis team attended the 2026 Taiwan PCB Industry International Exhibition (TPCA Show) and visited Xinxing (3037) to learn about high‑end AI server PCBs and optical communication layouts.

Xinxing is concentrating its resources on AI servers, switches and high‑end HDI products; HDI already has a 60‑layer sample, while optical communication is moving step‑by‑step from 800G to 1.6T and continues to monitor next‑generation optical architectures such as NPO and CPO.

AI server boards are advancing toward high‑end HDI, and Xinxing’s 60‑layer sample is now available. The interviewee noted that AI server and switch boards now have 30‑40 layers, with some boards weighing 6‑7 kilograms, raising the demands on equipment transmission, process capability, and line width/spacing.
The company is currently focusing on compute trays, switch trays and networking trays, with HDI samples already reaching up to 60 layers.

As high‑end materials evolve from M8 to M9, material costs and equipment investment will also rise, but the speed of introducing new materials and processes still depends on customer design and investment timelines.

In optical modules, the interviewee said that 800G entered mass production in 2025‑early 2026, and the next development focus shifts to 1.6T, with ongoing evaluation of NPO, CPO and other architectures.
Plug‑in optical modules remain mainstream at this stage, but as transmission rates increase, DSP power consumption and switch heat‑dissipation pressures become more pronounced.
For a 1.6T optical module, DSP power consumption is about 25 watts; if a switch is equipped with multiple optical modules, overall thermal management will become a critical challenge.

NPO aims to place the optical module closer to the switch ASIC, shortening signal transmission distance and reducing DSP specifications and power needs; CPO goes further by integrating optical components with the ASIC.
The interviewee believes the next‑generation architectures are still in R&D and evaluation stages, with NPO being the most noteworthy direction at present.

Whether Xinxing can leverage its high‑end HDI capability and AI customer experience to capture the demand for new‑generation optical communication architectures will be a key point to watch going forward.

items.title_en: Zhen Ding-KY (4958) Spotlights NPO Optical Module PCB Design: Layer Count Shifts from 22 to 18, Embedded Silicon Capacitors Emerging as a New Trend
paras: 2026年10月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 優分析團隊前往2026年台灣電路板產業國際展覽會(TPCA Show)，實際訪問臻鼎-KY(4958)，深入了解NPO光模組的PCB設計、內埋被動元件與高階材料趨勢。
受訪者指出，NPO板層設計已出現從22層朝18層精簡的趨勢，部分領先業者也開始探索內埋矽電容，材料方面則以Meg8等級作為目前值得關注的方向。

NPO板層設計持續精簡，18層成目前觀察重點
受訪者表示，NPO板層數與客戶的晶片選擇、訊號完整性（SI）及電源完整性（PI）設計能力密切相關。
相同晶片架構，不同客戶可能採用16層、18層或22層設計；依目前觀察，部分方案已從22層降至16至18層，18層是受訪者認為目前較具代表性的設計上限。
此外，晶片的I/O數量、整合程度與效能，也會影響板層需求。
若採用較多顆功能相對單純的晶片，設計就可能需要更多走線與電源配置，進而增加板層及被動元件配置難度。
因此，未來競爭不只在於能否製作高層板，也在於能否透過設計能力降低層數、兼顧訊號品質與成本。

內埋矽電容進入前沿探索，解決板面空間不足
被動元件方面，受訪者認為內埋技術是長期發展趨勢，目前資料中心電源供應器已開始受到關注，光模組領域也有領先業者探索將陶瓷電容、矽電容等元件埋入板內。
部分NPO方案的內埋電容數量約10至50顆，但仍屬前沿探索階段，不能視為已全面量產。
隨著光電晶片與周邊元件增加，板面空間逐漸吃緊，內埋元件有助於釋放表面空間，也可能改善高密度設計的配置彈性。
若未來NPO架構持續發展，具備精細線路與內埋製程能力的PCB供應商，將有機會受惠於設計複雜度提升。

NPO材料以Meg8為觀察重點，PTFE仍有損耗考量
高階材料方面，受訪者認為，現階段部分NPO設計使用Meg8等級材料可能已足夠，Meg9、Meg10則仍有預研需求；PTFE覆銅板雖具備高頻應用潛力，但受訪者指出，在相關評估中仍存在電氣損耗等考量，現階段並不認為NPO一定需要採用PTFE。
不過，材料需求仍取決於光學架構、元件性能與訊號傳輸距離。
隨著單通道速率朝400G發展，NPO、CPO及其他整合式架構持續演進，PCB材料規格也可能隨之改變。
後續仍須觀察客戶實際設計、材料驗證與量產進度，才能判斷高階材料及內埋製程帶來的營收機會。

paras_en: On October 20, 2026 (reported by You Analysis/Industry Data Center), the You Analysis team visited the 2026 Taiwan PCB Industry International Exhibition (TPCA Show) and conducted an on‑site interview with Zhen Ding‑KY (4958) to gain deep insight into NPO optical module PCB design, embedded passive components, and advanced material trends.

The interviewee noted that NPO board layer designs are trending toward simplification, moving from 22 layers down to 18 layers, and that some leading companies are beginning to explore embedded silicon capacitors, while materials such as Meg8 are currently the most noteworthy focus.

NPO board layer designs continue to be streamlined, with 18 layers now the primary focus of observation. The interviewee explained that the number of layers in an NPO board is closely linked to the customer's chip selection as well as signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) design capabilities.

For the same chip architecture, different customers may adopt 16‑, 18‑, or 22‑layer designs; based on current observations, some solutions have already been reduced from 22 layers to 16‑18 layers, and 18 layers is considered by the interviewee to be the representative upper limit for designs at present.
In addition, the number of I/O pins, integration level, and performance of the chip also affect the board‑layer requirements.

If a design uses a larger number of relatively simple functional chips, more routing and power distribution are needed, which in turn raises the difficulty of board‑layer and passive‑component placement.

Therefore, future competition will hinge not only on the ability to produce high‑layer boards but also on the capability to reduce layer count through design expertise while maintaining signal quality and cost efficiency.

Embedded silicon capacitors are entering frontier exploration, addressing insufficient board surface space. Regarding passive components, the interviewee sees embedded technology as a long‑term development trend; data‑center power supplies have already attracted attention, and leading players in the optical module field are exploring embedding ceramic and silicon capacitors within the board.
Some NPO solutions embed roughly 10 to 50 capacitors, but this remains an early‑stage exploration and cannot yet be considered full‑scale mass production.

As optical chips and peripheral components increase, board surface space becomes increasingly constrained; embedded components help free up surface area and may also improve layout flexibility for high‑density designs.
If NPO architectures continue to evolve, PCB suppliers with fine‑line routing and embedded‑process capabilities will stand to benefit from the rising design complexity.

Meg8 is the focal point for NPO material observation, while PTFE still raises loss concerns. Regarding advanced materials, the interviewee believes that for many current NPO designs, Meg8‑grade material may be sufficient, whereas Meg9 and Meg10 still require pre‑research; although PTFE copper‑clad boards have high‑frequency potential, the interviewee points out that electrical loss considerations remain in evaluations, and PTFE is not deemed essential for NPO at this stage.
Nevertheless, material needs still depend on the optical architecture, component performance, and signal transmission distance.
With single‑channel rates advancing toward 400 Gb/s, NPO, CPO, and other integrated architectures continue to evolve, and PCB material specifications may change accordingly.

Ongoing observation of actual customer designs, material verification, and mass‑production progress will be required to determine the revenue opportunities presented by advanced materials and embedded processes.

paras: 一、盤勢結構與技術面：量縮拉回，短線仍待止穩

台股今日呈現「量縮震盪拉回整理」格局，終場下跌 529點，收在46,292點，成交值萎縮至約 7,625億元，顯示市場追價意願不足，短線仍受國際利空與籌碼調節壓抑。
技術面方面，短線須觀察指數能否在前波低點附近獲得支撐，尤其 8月25日止跌紅K棒區間44,210～45,169點，可列為重要參考支撐區，但仍須搭配量價及買盤變化確認。
上檔則須留意 10日線與月線能否重新站回。若量能回溫、指數突破均線反壓，才有機會確認反彈力道增強。


二、影響盤勢因素：國際利空未除，市場信心仍待修復

美國通膨黏性高於預期，增添利率政策不確定性；AI投資報酬與獲利變現疑慮尚未完全消除，加上中國長鑫存儲擴產帶來產業競爭壓力，使科技股評價面臨考驗。
融資餘額居高不下，外資與自營商持續調節，反映市場籌碼仍待沉澱。短線即使出現反彈，也須提防解套賣壓與反彈不連續的風險。
後續觀察重點包括新台幣能否止貶回升、外資期現貨賣壓是否收斂、費半指數能否止跌，以及國際AI龍頭釋出的產業訊息。


三、籌碼與資金面：外資賣壓沉重，ETF與政策資金提供支撐

外資今日賣超約 795.4億元，今年以來累計賣超達 2.11兆元，顯示外資態度仍偏保守；惟後續若國際環境改善、匯率趨穩，不排除出現回補行情，但仍須觀察實際買盤。
依據原文資料，台股ETF今年平均每月淨流入約1,300億元，投信前九月累計買超約7,800億元，顯示內資仍具一定承接能力。
國家隊與ETF資金可望在市場回檔時提供支撐，但不代表指數不會進一步修正，仍應以成交量、法人動向及關鍵價位作為判斷依據。


四、中長期基本面：出口與企業獲利成長，AI仍是重要支柱

台灣9月出口達 872.2億美元，年增60.9%，連續35個月正成長，反映AI、高效能運算及電子供應鏈需求仍具韌性。
展望第四季，Vera Rubin平台、Google TPU等新世代AI晶片逐步推進，將帶動先進製程、ASIC、CoWoS、PCB、伺服器、液冷散熱、電源管理及光通訊等供應鏈需求。
原文引用的市場預估指出，2026年台股企業獲利年增率可達53%，2027年與2028年仍有約24%及23%的成長空間。惟上述為預估值，後續仍須留意企業財報、資本支出與AI投資效益是否符合預期。


五、產業與個股：聚焦AI供應鏈，留意低基期與相對抗跌族群

CPO與矽光子： AI晶片運算能力提升，帶動高速互連與光通訊需求，CPO有望成為長期技術發展方向，但仍須追蹤商業化進度及實際訂單。
AI硬體與高階材料： ASIC、PCB／CCL、玻纖布、先進封裝、被動元件及高階耗材，仍是市場關注主軸。

六、後市展望與操作策略：汰弱留強、分批布局，不追漲殺跌

短線： 國際利空與法人賣壓尚未解除，指數仍可能震盪探底，不宜因單日反彈就認定落底，也不宜因下跌而恐慌殺出。
中長線： AI產業趨勢與台灣出口基本面仍具支撐，若指數逐步止穩、外資賣壓收斂，且重新站回10日線及月線，可再觀察反彈延續性。
選股策略： 反彈汰弱留強，優先挑選基本面明確、訂單能見度高、流動性佳且股價相對抗跌的優質標的；低基期轉機股則須確認營運改善，避免單純追逐題材。
風險控管： 採分批布局、保留現金、設定停損與持股比重上限，避免融資重押或盲目接刀。


總結
台股目前處於「短線籌碼修正、中長期基本面仍具支撐」的關鍵階段。真正值得掌握的，不是猜測指數何時最低，而是等待賣壓收斂、技術面止穩，再從AI供應鏈中挑選具備實質獲利成長與資金關注的標的。

items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission: Over 12,200 Taiwanese Have Designated Anti‑Fraud Contacts; E.Sun and Taipei Fubon Lead Promotion
paras: 為守護國人財產安全，金管會積極推動「大額匯款或定存解約通知指定聯絡人」防詐服務。截至今(2026)年7月底止，已有 12,580 位民眾完成申辦；截至9月底，全台已有 24 家銀行開辦此項服務，另有 7 家本國銀行及中華郵政公司預計於明(2027)年 6 月底前陸續上線。在各家金融機構中，玉山銀行與台北富邦銀行表現最為突出，積極落實關懷與推廣機制，獲得金管會特別點名表揚。
根據金管會統計，截至 7 月底，申辦件數前二大的銀行皆展現強大的防詐推廣力道，玉山銀行以 7,542 件居全台之冠，推廣成效卓著；台北富邦銀行以 3,426 件位居第二，表現同樣相當亮眼；聯邦銀行則以 986 件 排名第三。
銀行局副局長王允中會中特別分享成功的攔阻案例，日前有一名客戶至玉山銀行分行欲辦理匯款，並稱該筆款項為「房屋裝潢費」。行員警覺性極高，查閱資料後發現客戶先前已申辦「指定聯絡人」服務，便第一時間聯繫其妻。妻子獲報趕到現場後表示，兩人雖曾討論過裝潢，但絕未到匯款階段，當場極力阻止。事後證實，該名客戶確實遭遇詐騙，成功保住高達 30 萬元的積蓄。
王允中指出，該服務採「自由申請、自主指定」原則，民眾可預先註記信任的親友(如配偶、子女、教授等)為聯絡人，且能隨時彈性變更。當發生定存解約或轉匯超過一定金額(門檻由各銀行與客戶個別約定)時，銀行將第一時間通知指定聯絡人。
他強調，此服務完全免費，不僅能維持客戶財務隱私與交易自主權，更能透過親友及時的關懷與查證，降低民眾獨自做出重大財務決定而被騙的風險，讓防詐工作從「事後追查」跨越至「事前預防、即時辨識與及早攔阻」。
除銀行業外，金管會保險局亦積極鼓勵壽險業者推動保單指定聯絡人機制(如辦理保單借款或解約時通知)。截至今年 8 月 10 日止，壽險業申辦人數已達 38,225 人，前三大業者分別為富邦人壽(13,238人)、南山人壽(7,737人)及國泰人壽(7,267人)。至於投信事業之基金贖回業務，證期局表示目前尚無類似指定聯絡人之機制。
金管會強調，防詐不能單靠單一機制，呼籲民眾多與家人討論防詐觀念，特別是家中長輩或較少接觸金融服務者，可主動向往來銀行洽詢並完成約定，共同建立防護網。金管會每年亦會舉辦打詐頒獎機制，公開表揚積極攔阻詐騙的金融機構，鼓勵各界持續推動防詐作為。
paras_en: To protect citizens' financial safety, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) has been actively promoting an anti‑fraud service that notifies a designated contact person for large remittances or time‑deposit cancellations. By the end of July 2026, 12,580 people had completed the registration; by the end of September, 24 banks nationwide were offering the service, with another seven domestic banks and Chunghwa Post slated to launch it by the end of June 2027. Among the institutions, E.Sun Bank and Taipei Fubon Bank stood out for their proactive care and promotion, earning special commendation from the FSC.

According to FSC data, as of the end of July the two banks with the highest number of registrations demonstrated strong anti‑fraud outreach. E.Sun Bank led the nation with 7,542 registrations, showing remarkable promotion results; Taipei Fubon Bank ranked second with 3,426 registrations, also a striking performance; and Union Bank placed third with 986 registrations.

Deputy Director‑General Wang Yunchung of the Banking Bureau shared a successful interception case at a recent forum. A customer visited an E.Sun branch to make a remittance, claiming the funds were for “home renovation.” The teller, highly alert, checked the customer’s records and found that the customer had previously enrolled in the designated‑contact service, so the teller immediately contacted the customer’s spouse. The spouse arrived on the scene and said that, although they had discussed renovation, no remittance had been approved, and she stopped the transaction. It was later confirmed that the customer was indeed targeted by a scam, and the service helped protect savings of up to NT$300,000.

Wang explained that the service operates on a “voluntary application, self‑designated” principle. Individuals can pre‑record trusted relatives or friends (such as a spouse, child, or professor) as contacts and can change them at any time. When a time‑deposit is terminated or a transfer exceeds a certain amount (the threshold is set individually by each bank and customer), the bank promptly notifies the designated contact.

He emphasized that the service is completely free, preserving customers’ financial privacy and transaction autonomy while allowing timely care and verification from trusted contacts. This reduces the risk of individuals being scammed when making major financial decisions alone, shifting anti‑fraud work from “post‑incident investigation” to “pre‑emptive prevention, real‑time identification and early interception.”

Beyond banking, the FSC’s Insurance Bureau is also encouraging life‑insurance companies to adopt a designated‑contact mechanism for policy loans or cancellations. As of August 10 this year, 38,225 people had signed up, with the top three providers being Fubon Life (13,238), Nan Shan Life (7,737) and Cathay Life (7,267). For mutual‑fund redemptions, the Securities and Futures Bureau noted that no similar designated‑contact system currently exists.

The FSC stressed that anti‑fraud efforts cannot rely on a single mechanism, urging the public to discuss fraud‑prevention concepts with family members, especially seniors or those less familiar with financial services, and to proactively inquire with their banks about enrolling in the program to build a shared protection network. The FSC also holds an annual anti‑fraud award ceremony to publicly recognize financial institutions that actively block scams, encouraging continued industry‑wide anti‑fraud initiatives.

items.title: 尖點(8021)直擊M9鑽針新挑戰！AI伺服器高階板鑽針壽命大減，抗磨耗技術成關鍵
items.title_en: Sharp Point (8021) Faces New M9 Drill Bit Challenge! AI Server High-End PCB Drill Bit Life Drastically Reduced, Wear-Resistant Technology Becomes Critical
paras: 2026年10月20日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 優分析團隊前往2026年台灣電路板產業國際展覽會，實際訪問尖點(8021)研發人員，深入了解AI伺服器高階PCB的加工挑戰。
隨著M9材料與高層板厚度提升，鑽針面臨更大的磨耗、斷針與加工精度考驗，市場關注的焦點也從鑽孔需求成長，延伸至鑽針壽命與製程穩定性。

M9高層板厚達8mm，分段鑽孔降低斷針風險
尖點研發人員指出，M9高層板厚度約6至8mm，部分達56層，單一孔位可能需要搭配3至4支鑽針分段加工，以降低排屑阻力與斷針風險。
此外，鑽孔時的摩擦與溫度變化，也可能拉扯銅層、造成ICD斷路，必須透過鑽針結構與加工條件改善穩定性。
隨著M9加工難度提高，如何延長鑽針壽命、維持加工精度，將是重要競爭關鍵。

ABF重視抗磨耗，下一代材料帶來新商機與挑戰
相較M9厚板加工，ABF載板更重視高孔數、抗磨耗與精度，鑽針設計須配合材料特性調整。
尖點研發人員也表示，PTFE與碳氫複合材料目前仍處於測試階段，需要鑽針廠與板材商共同開發；玻璃基板則可能面臨機械鑽孔崩邊問題，相關加工技術仍待驗證。
隨著AI伺服器朝低損耗材料發展，尖點能否持續提升鑽針耐磨耗能力，並配合新材料開發，將是後續值得觀察的方向。

paras_en: October 20, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The U-Analysis team visited the 2026 Taiwan Circuit Board Industry International Exhibition and interviewed Sharp Point (8021) R&D staff to gain an in‑depth understanding of the processing challenges of high‑end AI server PCBs.

As M9 material and high‑layer board thickness increase, drill bits encounter greater wear, breakage and precision challenges. Market focus has shifted from growing drilling demand to drill‑bit lifespan and process stability.

M9 high‑layer boards can be up to 8 mm thick, with some reaching 56 layers. A single hole may require 3‑4 drill bits in staged drilling to reduce chip‑ejection resistance and the risk of breakage, according to Sharp Point engineers.

In addition, friction and temperature changes during drilling can pull on copper layers and cause ICD open circuits, requiring improvements in drill‑bit structure and processing conditions to enhance stability.
With M9 processing becoming more difficult, extending drill‑bit life while maintaining machining accuracy will be a key competitive factor.

ABF places greater emphasis on wear resistance, and the next‑generation material brings new business opportunities and challenges. Compared with thick‑board M9 processing, ABF substrates focus more on high hole counts, wear resistance and precision, requiring drill‑bit designs to be adjusted to material characteristics.

Sharp Point’s R&D staff also noted that PTFE and hydrocarbon composite materials are still in testing and need joint development by drill‑bit manufacturers and board suppliers; glass substrates may face mechanical drilling chipping issues, and related processing technologies remain to be validated.
As AI servers move toward low‑loss materials, whether Sharp Point can continuously improve drill‑bit wear resistance and cooperate with new material development will be a direction worth watching.
