items.title: 聯茂中長期擴產腳步不停歇 高階產品產能持續提升
items.title_en: Lianmao Continues Long-Term Capacity Expansion, Boosting High-End Product Output
paras: CCL廠聯茂(6213-TW)持續深耕AI應用，高階膠系認證進度快馬加鞭，同時，在泰國、江西、無錫及台灣等生產基地大幅擴張產能，預計2026年合計總產能將達每月570萬張。進行三階投資與積極擴產，預計今年底完成第一期投資，產能將由每月30萬張翻倍增至60萬張。
依聯茂規劃，隨著終端市場對於 PCB 和CCL 的需求和規格不斷加速擴增，聯茂積極擴充無錫與泰國廠，預計2026/2027/2028/2029年底集團月產能分別達570萬/630萬/825萬/915萬張。
聯茂並指出，針對光傳輸上的技術發展，CPO(共同封裝光學)技術將光學模組與交換器晶片(ASIC)直接封裝在同一個載板上，取代傳統的可插拔式光收發模組，縮短電訊號傳輸距離。隨著電訊號傳輸距離變短，PCB的面積也會縮小；這意味著CPO處理訊號速度變快，PCB必須具有極低的傳輸耗損(Extreme low loss)，因此推動超低耗損材料升級需求。
聯茂泰國第二期的擴產也已打樁動工，預計將再增加每月30萬張產能，依公司規劃，泰國第二期初期規劃每月生產30萬張CCL，最快將於2026年投產；2029年聯茂全球總產能預計將擴張至每月915萬張。因應高頻與高速CCL市場需求大幅提升，聯茂持續提升泰國廠的技術層次，預計於2026年完成M8 CCL的技術轉移，並於2027年完成M9產品技術轉移至泰國。
隨著AI伺服器所需之關鍵高階銅箔基板(CCL)之需求不斷快速提升，市場研調機構(Trendforce)指出，AI需求將穩定驅動全球資料中心成長，自2023年起，全球主要CSP每年資本支出都呈現雙位數成長，未來也會是這樣，亦而驅動對PCB/CCL的需求以及材料提升。
聯茂持續深耕AI，高階膠系認證進度快馬加鞭；繼AI資料中心所需要的M9等級Extreme low loss超低耗損基板材料已於2025下半年通過主要美系AI GPU大廠及數家PCB板廠認證，將於不久未來開始放量之外；聯茂也於2026年推出M10無鹵超低損耗低延遲高速材料IT-Q10GSE4，M10材料已開始送樣至各大AI科技大廠認證，加緊配合AI大廠之需求持續優化其特性。

在scale-up架構下，CPO封裝體積變小但能量密度極高，對PCB的散熱能力與穩定性也提出了更高的要求，板材除超低耗損之外還須兼具低熱膨脹係數(Low CTE)。總而言之，CPO促使PCB從傳統資料傳輸轉向高階、細線路、高散熱的矽光子封裝板材發展；因應Low CTE、高信賴性、類載板等等需求，聯茂開發完整多元Low CTE 6-系列之高速材料，並已開始和多家HDI/載板 PCB大廠進行產品送樣認證，未來不會錯過此利基技術的良機
高階伺服器CPU主板上，聯茂對應PCIe Gen 6伺服器平台之M7無鹵超低電性耗損材料IT-988GL已通過各大伺服器ODM終端及PCB板廠認證，並即將開始陸續放量。
隨著汽車朝向電動化及智能化發展，車用PCB技術及規格亦有所提升，在新能源車市崛起擴大車用電子對高速高頻材料需求下，平均而言，電動車PCB使用量為傳統燃油車的四倍以上，就綠能環保議題非常重視的聯茂在EV、無鹵和高速車用電子市場的布局領先群雄。聯茂的高信賴性、Hi-tg無鹵、耐高電壓CAF材料等BMS相關產品應用於PHEV、MHEV、BEV持續放量於歐美一線客戶。

此外，聯茂應用於車聯網和ADAS & AD Domain之高速材料持續加速放量於各大歐美客戶。未來在5G/6G網路以及AI邊緣運算應用快速佈建下，車用電子對於高速高頻材料的需求持續擴大，聯茂應用於Telematics和ADAS & AD Domain之HDI無鹵高速材料也將於2027年加速放量至歐系大廠；針對HPC與全自動駕駛Autopilot應用之HDI無鹵/超低耗損高速材料目前也已導入於各第一線歐美車用大廠。
paras_en: CCL plant Lianmao (6213-TW) keeps deepening its AI applications, accelerating certification of high-end adhesive systems, while dramatically expanding capacity at production bases in Thailand, Jiangxi, Wuxi and Taiwan, with total monthly capacity expected to reach 5.7 million sheets by 2026. The company is undertaking a three‑stage investment and aggressive expansion, aiming to complete phase‑one by year‑end, doubling monthly capacity from 300,000 to 600,000 sheets.

According to Lianmao’s plan, as end‑market demand and specifications for PCBs and CCLs continue to surge, the firm is actively expanding its Wuxi and Thailand facilities, targeting group monthly capacities of 5.7 million, 6.3 million, 8.25 million and 9.15 million sheets by the end of 2026, 2027, 2028 and 2029 respectively.

Lianmao noted that for optical‑transmission technology development, CPO (Co‑Package Optics) integrates optical modules and ASICs on the same substrate, replacing traditional pluggable optical transceiver modules and shortening electrical signal paths. Shorter signal distances reduce PCB area, meaning CPO can process signals faster and requires PCBs with extreme low loss, driving demand for ultra‑low‑loss material upgrades.

The second phase of Lianmao’s Thailand expansion has broken ground, adding another 300,000 sheets per month. The company plans an initial output of 300,000 sheets of CCL per month in phase‑two, with the earliest commissioning in 2026; by 2029 global capacity is projected to reach 9.15 million sheets per month. To meet rising high‑frequency and high‑speed CCL demand, Lianmao is upgrading the Thailand plant’s technology, targeting M8 CCL technology transfer in 2026 and M9 product transfer in 2027.

As AI servers’ demand for high‑end copper foil substrates (CCL) rapidly climbs, market research firm Trendforce says AI demand will consistently drive global data‑center growth. Since 2023, major CSPs have posted double‑digit annual cap‑ex growth, a trend expected to continue, further boosting PCB/CCL demand and material upgrades.

Lianmao continues to deepen its AI focus, accelerating high‑end adhesive certification. The M9‑grade extreme‑low‑loss substrate required by AI data centers passed certification by major US AI‑GPU vendors and several PCB manufacturers in the second half of 2025 and will soon enter volume production. In 2026 the company will launch M10 halogen‑free ultra‑low‑loss, low‑latency high‑speed material IT‑Q10GSE4, with samples already sent to major AI firms for qualification, tightening alignment with AI‑chip makers’ needs.

In a scale‑up architecture, CPO packages become smaller yet have very high energy density, raising PCB thermal‑management and stability requirements. Beyond ultra‑low loss, board material must also feature low coefficient of thermal expansion (Low CTE). In short, CPO pushes PCB development from traditional data transmission toward high‑end, fine‑line, high‑thermal‑dissipation silicon‑photonics packaging boards. To meet Low CTE, high‑reliability, substrate‑like demands, Lianmao has developed a full suite of Low CTE 6‑series high‑speed materials and has begun sample submissions to multiple HDI/substrate PCB leaders, positioning itself to capture this niche technology opportunity.

For high‑end server CPU boards, Lianmao’s M7 halogen‑free ultra‑low‑loss material IT‑988GL, designed for PCIe Gen 6 platforms, has passed certification by major server ODMs and PCB manufacturers and will soon ramp up production.

As automobiles shift toward electrification and intelligence, automotive PCB technology and specifications are also advancing. With the rise of new‑energy vehicles expanding demand for high‑frequency, high‑speed materials, electric‑vehicle PCBs use more than four times the amount of PCB material compared with conventional gasoline cars. Lianmao, emphasizing green energy, leads the market in EV, halogen‑free and high‑speed automotive electronics, with its high‑reliability, Hi‑tg halogen‑free, high‑voltage CAF materials for BMS applications seeing growing volumes among top European and American customers for PHEV, MHEV and BEV models.

Furthermore, Lianmao’s high‑speed materials for telematics and ADAS/AD domains are rapidly scaling with major European and American customers. As 5G/6G networks and AI edge computing are rapidly deployed, automotive electronics’ demand for high‑frequency, high‑speed materials continues to grow. Lianmao’s HDI halogen‑free high‑speed materials for telematics and ADAS/AD will accelerate volume shipments to European OEMs by 2027, and its HDI halogen‑free/ultra‑low‑loss materials for HPC and full‑autonomous driving (Autopilot) applications have already been introduced to leading European and American automotive manufacturers.

items.title: 〈外銷訂單〉連19紅！9月1142億美元年增62% 全年可望破兆
items.title_en: Export Orders Hit 19-Month Streak of Growth: September Reaches $114.21 B, Up 62% YoY, Full-Year Likely to Break the Trillion‑Dollar Mark
paras: 經濟部今（20）日公布115年9月外銷訂單統計，受惠於人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算及雲端服務需求持續強勁，加上消費性電子新品陸續上市帶動拉貨動能，9月外銷訂單金額高達1,142.1億美元，較上月大幅增加112.5億美元或10.9%，與去年同月相比更爆增438.7億美元，年增率攀升至62.4%。8、9月更是連續2個月衝破千億美元大關，刷新連續19個月正成長紀錄。
據統計顯示，AI與新興科技應用全面爆發，推升電子與資訊通信產品接單大攀升，累計前3季外銷訂單已達8,192億美元，年增56%，整體接單表現極具韌性與成長爆發力，估全年可望破兆美元。

AI與消費電子新品雙引擎 科技貨品接單強強滾

按主要接單貨品觀察，新興科技應用熱絡成為最核心支撐力道。9月資訊通信產品接單金額達438.8億美元，較上月成長28.3%，年增率高達87.3%，主因AI、資料中心及雲端產業持續擴展，帶動伺服器、網通產品、手機、筆電及工業電腦等訂單顯著成長；累計前3季資訊通信產品年增幅高達87.6%。
電子產品表現同樣強眼，9月接單金額達474.2億美元，月增3.6%，年增71.0%，主要得益於高效能運算與AI需求攀升，推升IC製造、記憶體、晶片通路及IC設計等接單成長。相對而言，光學器材9月接單19.7億美元，年減5.6%，主因面板需求仍趨保守，不過半導體產業對光學檢測與量測設備的需求持續成長，抵銷了部分減幅。

傳統產業受惠AI供應鏈與原物料價格 呈全面回溫

在傳統貨品方面，隨著全球半導體業者擴大資本支出，加上國際油價與原料上漲推升產品售價，傳統產業接單同步顯著回溫。基本金屬製品9月接單24.3億美元，年增29.7%，主要受惠AI供應鏈對銅箔及銅箔基板的需求帶動；機械產品接單21.9億美元，年增21.5%，主因半導體設備與自動化設備需求擴增。
此外，化學品與塑橡膠製品9月接單分別為17.1億美元及15.3億美元，年增率分別達到22.8%與11.4%，顯示AI鏈效應已外溢至基礎材料與化學品工業。

美歐接單極度火熱 美國市場年增近8成

從主要接單地區來看，各大市場普遍展現強勁拉貨力道。其中以美國市場最為亮眼，9月接自美國訂單高達453.8億美元，月增7.7%，年增率更高達79.4%，主要由資訊通信產品大幅增加102.9億美元（增117.6%）所貢獻。
東協地區9月接單208.5億美元，年增41.1%，以電子產品增加42.8億美元居多；中國大陸及香港接單182.1億美元，年增48.5%，主要亦由電子產品拉動（年增66.6%）；歐洲地區接單148.9億美元，月增35.8%，年增68.0%，同樣以資訊通信產品拉貨最為顯著；日本接單則為42.9億美元，年增35.5%。

展望未來：國際不確定性仍在 但10月接單看升

經濟部統計處分析，全球經貿發展雖然仍受到地緣政治及國際貿易政策等不確定性因素牽動，但各國與全球雲端服務業者（CSP）正積極布建AI基礎建設，台灣半導體與伺服器供應鏈位於全球關鍵核心地位，可望持續挹注接單成長動能。
根據外銷訂單受查廠商對10月份接單的看法，按接單金額計算之動向指數為50.5，顯示廠商預期10月份整體外銷訂單金額將較9月份持續增加，接單動能可望維持高檔運作。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs today (Oct 20) released September 2024 export order statistics. Benefiting from sustained strong demand for artificial intelligence (AI), high‑performance computing and cloud services, as well as the rollout of new consumer‑electronics products that boosted shipment momentum, September export orders amounted to $114.21 billion, up $11.25 billion or 10.9% from the previous month and soaring $43.87 billion versus the same month last year, a year‑over‑year increase of 62.4%. August and September marked the second consecutive month of exceeding $100 billion, extending a 19‑month growth streak.

Statistics show that AI and emerging‑technology applications have exploded across the board, driving a sharp rise in orders for electronic and information‑communication products. Cumulative export orders for the first three quarters have reached $819.2 billion, up 56% year‑over‑year, indicating that overall order performance remains highly resilient and growth‑driven, with the full‑year likely to surpass the trillion‑dollar threshold.

AI and new consumer‑electronics products act as dual engines, propelling strong order growth for technology goods. Looking at the main product categories, emerging‑technology applications are the core support. September information‑communication product orders hit $43.88 billion, up 28.3% month‑over‑month and 87.3% year‑over‑year, driven by continued expansion in AI, data‑center and cloud sectors, which boosted orders for servers, networking gear, smartphones, laptops and industrial PCs; cumulative year‑over‑year growth for information‑communication products in the first three quarters was 87.6%.

Electronic products also performed robustly, with September orders reaching $47.42 billion, up 3.6% month‑over‑month and 71.0% year‑over‑year, mainly thanks to rising demand for high‑performance computing and AI that lifted orders for IC manufacturing, memory, chip distribution and IC design. By contrast, optical equipment orders fell to $1.97 billion in September, down 5.6% year‑over‑year, as panel demand remained cautious; however, semiconductor industry demand for optical inspection and measurement equipment continued to grow, offsetting part of the decline.

Traditional industries benefited from the AI supply chain and higher raw‑material prices, showing a broad recovery. For traditional goods, global semiconductor firms are expanding capital expenditures, and rising international oil and raw‑material prices have pushed product prices up, leading to a notable rebound in orders. Basic metal product orders in September were $2.43 billion, up 29.7% year‑over‑year, mainly driven by AI‑related demand for copper foil and copper‑foil substrates; machinery product orders were $2.19 billion, up 21.5% year‑over‑year, reflecting increased demand for semiconductor and automation equipment.

In addition, chemical and plastic‑rubber product orders in September were $1.71 billion and $1.53 billion respectively, with year‑over‑year growth rates of 22.8% and 11.4%, showing that AI‑chain effects have spilled over into basic materials and the chemicals industry.

U.S. and European orders are extremely hot, with the U.S. market showing a near‑80% annual increase. By region, the United States stood out, with September orders from the U.S. reaching $45.38 billion, up 7.7% month‑over‑month and 79.4% year‑over‑year, largely contributed by a $10.29 billion surge (up 117.6%) in information‑communication product orders.

The ASEAN region recorded September orders of $20.85 billion, up 41.1% year‑over‑year, driven mainly by a $4.28 billion increase in electronic products; mainland China and Hong Kong together posted $18.21 billion in orders, up 48.5% year‑over‑year, also led by electronics (up 66.6%); Europe logged $14.89 billion in orders, up $3.58 billion month‑over‑month and 68.0% year‑over‑year, again with information‑communication products leading the surge; Japan’s orders were $4.29 billion, up 35.5% year‑over‑year.

Outlook: International uncertainty remains, but October orders look set to rise. The Ministry’s Statistics Department notes that while global trade development is still influenced by geopolitical and trade‑policy uncertainties, countries and global cloud service providers (CSPs) are actively building AI infrastructure, and Taiwan’s semiconductor and server supply chains occupy a critical global position, which should continue to feed order‑growth momentum.

According to surveyed exporters’ views on October orders, the order‑trend index—based on order value—stands at 50.5, indicating that firms expect October’s total export orders to rise further from September, with order momentum likely to stay at a high level.

items.title: 輝達GTC大會即將登場 英特爾3大潛在受惠機會
items.title_en: NVIDIA GTC Conference Approaches, Three Potential Benefits for Intel
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 柏林 GTC 2026 大會本週登場，執行長黃仁勳預計於台灣時間週三 (21 日) 下午 5 點發表主題演講。科技媒體《Wccftech》分析指出，除了輝達自身的 AI 硬體布局，英特爾 (INTC-US) 能否在下一代產品中延續處理器合作，並進一步爭取晶圓代工與先進封裝訂單，也值得關注。
報導認為，若輝達釋出更多與英特爾合作的明確訊號，可能有助於改善市場對英特爾未來營收的預期。不過，涉及下一代 Feynman 架構的代工與封裝合作，目前仍屬市場傳聞，尚未獲得雙方正式確認。
柏林 GTC 工作坊於 10 月 20 日舉行，會議與展覽則安排在 21 至 22 日。黃仁勳的主題演講預定於柏林時間 21 日上午 11 點開始，換算台灣時間為當天下午 5 點。
處理器合作是英特爾最具實質基礎的受惠方向。
根據輝達官方規格，採用 Blackwell Ultra GPU 的 DGX B300，以及採用 Rubin GPU 的 DGX Rubin NVL8，均搭載英特爾 Xeon 6776P 處理器，其中 DGX Rubin NVL8 配置 2 顆 Xeon CPU。
這意味著，即使輝達持續擴大自研 CPU 布局，英特爾仍在部分 DGX 系統中扮演主機端處理器供應商的角色。
不過，既有產品採用 Xeon 已是公開資訊，柏林大會的觀察重點，在於這項合作是否延伸至後續產品世代。
輝達今年 3 月已揭露，下一代 Feynman 平台將納入自研 Rosa CPU。
《Wccftech》推測，部分 Feynman 架構 DGX 系統仍可能採用 Xeon，但這項配置目前尚未獲得官方確認。
晶圓代工則是另一項潛在機會。
市場傳聞指出，輝達可能採用英特爾 18A-P 或 14A 製程，製造 Feynman 世代的輸入／輸出 (I/O) 晶粒。若合作獲得證實，將有助於市場評估英特爾爭取外部代工客戶的進展，但目前製程選擇、訂單規模與生產時程均未明朗。
先進封裝方面，英特爾的 EMIB-T 與 Foveros 亦列為觀察方向，輝達未來是否可能採用其相關技術。
輝達今年持續推進 AI 平台布局，早在 3 月 16 日就已宣布，Vera Rubin 平台的 7 款晶片全面進入量產。此次柏林大會則讓市場有機會進一步了解其歐洲 AI 生態系與後續產品規劃。
對英特爾而言，這場活動的意義在於既有 CPU 合作能否延續，以及代工、封裝傳聞能否出現更具體的依據。至於英特爾能否比輝達本身獲得更大的市場效益，仍有待正式公告與實際訂單驗證。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) will hold its Berlin GTC 2026 conference this week, with CEO Jensen Huang scheduled to deliver a keynote at 5 p.m. Taiwan time on Wednesday (the 21st). Tech outlet Wccftech notes that beyond NVIDIA’s own AI hardware roadmap, it is worth watching whether Intel (INTC-US) can continue processor collaborations in next‑generation products and further win wafer‑fab and advanced‑packaging orders.

The report suggests that if NVIDIA signals more concrete cooperation with Intel, it could improve market expectations for Intel’s future revenue. However, any fab and packaging collaboration on the next‑gen Feynman architecture remains market rumor and has not been officially confirmed by either side.

The Berlin GTC workshops take place on October 20, with the conference and exhibition scheduled for the 21st‑22nd. Huang’s keynote is set to start at 11 a.m. Berlin time on the 21st, which is 5 p.m. Taiwan time that day.
Processor collaboration is the most tangible benefit avenue for Intel.

According to NVIDIA’s official specifications, the DGX B300 using the Blackwell Ultra GPU and the DGX Rubin NVL8 using the Rubin GPU both incorporate Intel Xeon 6776P processors, with the DGX Rubin NVL8 equipped with two Xeon CPUs.
This means that even as NVIDIA expands its own CPU designs, Intel still serves as the host‑side processor supplier for certain DGX systems.
However, the use of Xeon in existing products is already public; the key observation at the Berlin event is whether this cooperation will extend to future product generations.
NVIDIA disclosed in March that its next‑generation Feynman platform will include its own Rosa CPU.
Wccftech speculates that some Feynman‑based DGX systems may still use Xeon, but this configuration has not yet been officially confirmed.
Wafer fabrication represents another potential opportunity.

Market rumors indicate NVIDIA might use Intel’s 18A‑P or 14A process nodes to manufacture I/O chips for the Feynman generation. If confirmed, this would help assess Intel’s progress in winning external fab customers, though the chosen node, order size, and production timeline remain unclear.
On the advanced‑packaging front, Intel’s EMIB‑T and Foveros technologies are also being watched to see if NVIDIA may adopt them in the future.

NVIDIA continues to advance its AI platform rollout, having announced on March 16 that all seven chips of the Vera Rubin platform have entered volume production. The Berlin conference gives the market a chance to learn more about its European AI ecosystem and upcoming product plans.

For Intel, the event’s significance lies in whether existing CPU collaborations will continue and whether fab and packaging rumors will gain concrete footing. Whether Intel can capture greater market benefit than NVIDIA itself remains to be seen pending official announcements and actual orders.

items.title: AI暫時退位！能源股財報季有望領跑 獲利年增128%是科技業兩倍
items.title_en: AI Takes a Temporary Backseat! Energy Stocks Expected to Lead Earnings Season with 128% YoY Profit Growth, Double the Tech Sector
paras: 能源類股將於周二(20日)揭開財報季序幕，表現預料相當亮眼，根據FactSet彙整的最新預估，標普500指數能源類股第3季EPS預估年增128%，成長幅度約為科技業的兩倍。
不過，能源業獲利年增率可能不及第2季，當時國際油價平均每桶98美元，帶動能源企業獲利年增146%。第3季平均油價則小幅回落至每桶91美元。
儘管如此，從某些角度來看，第3季獲利仍能成長更令人意外。不久前多數分析師仍預期，伊朗戰爭將在夏季中間開始降溫，但如今戰事仍持續延燒，而且看不到明確的結束跡象。
巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，包括埃克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的多檔能源股，股價已來到或接近歷史高點，讓投資人對股價進一步上漲的期待也隨之提高。
目前能源企業面臨的最大問題是，打算如何運用豐沛的現金，以及是否會把握這次機會增加鑽探活動。

美國鑽井活動回溫 哈里伯頓獲利仍缺乏成長

油田服務公司哈里伯頓(Halliburton)(HAL-US)將於周二率先公布能源業財報，正好有機會滿足市場對鑽探活動的關注。
哈里伯頓是美國頁岩油產業規模最大的油田服務公司，而頁岩油占美國石油產量的最大比重。隨著美國石油生產商增加作業活動，鑽井平台數在多年下滑後終於再度回升，美國陸上鑽井平台數量今年已增加10%。
不過，油商活動仍須進一步大幅成長，才能真正帶動油田服務類股。市場預估，哈里伯頓EPS為58美分，與去年同期持平。
即使如此，哈里伯頓預估的零成長率仍優於同業。在能源產業所有次產業中，哈里伯頓所屬的油田設備與服務業是唯一預期平均EPS將年減的類別。

漲勢落後其他能源股 委內瑞拉業務成潛在利多

部分分析師認為，哈里伯頓等油田服務公司之所以值得關注，正是因為它們尚未跟上其他能源股的漲勢。
哈里伯頓也持續拓展海外業務，並已就向委內瑞拉提供服務達成初步協議。如果這些協議最終落實，可能成為推動股價開始大幅上漲的契機。
paras_en: Energy stocks will kick off the earnings season on Tuesday (the 20th), and performance is expected to be quite bright. According to the latest estimates compiled by FactSet, S&P 500 energy sector earnings per share for Q3 are projected to rise 128% year‑over‑year, roughly twice the growth rate of the technology sector.

However, the energy sector’s year‑over‑year profit growth may not match Q2, when the average international oil price was $98 per barrel, driving a 146% YoY profit increase for energy companies. In Q3 the average price slipped slightly to $91 per barrel.

Nevertheless, from some angles the Q3 profit growth remains surprisingly strong. Not long ago most analysts still expected the Iran war to start cooling in mid‑summer, but the conflict continues to flare up with no clear end in sight.
Barron’s reported that several energy stocks, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), have reached or are near historic highs, raising investors’ expectations for further price gains.
The biggest question facing energy companies now is how they will deploy abundant cash and whether they will seize this chance to boost drilling activity.

U.S. drilling activity is warming up, and Halliburton’s profit still lacks growth. Oilfield services firm Halliburton (HAL‑US) will be the first to report energy‑sector earnings on Tuesday, giving the market a chance to gauge drilling activity.

Halliburton is the largest oilfield services company in the U.S. shale oil industry, and shale oil accounts for the biggest share of U.S. oil production. As U.S. producers increase operations, the number of drilling rigs, which had been declining for years, is finally rising again, with on‑shore rigs up 10% so far this year.
Nevertheless, oil‑company activity still needs to grow substantially to truly lift oilfield‑services stocks. The market estimates Halliburton’s EPS at $0.58, flat with the same quarter last year.

Even so, Halliburton’s zero‑growth outlook is still better than its peers. Among all sub‑sectors in the energy industry, Halliburton’s oil‑field equipment and services segment is the only one expected to see an average EPS decline.

The stock’s rally lags behind other energy shares, and its Venezuela business could be a potential catalyst. Some analysts say Halliburton and other oilfield‑services firms are worth watching precisely because they have not kept pace with the gains of other energy stocks.

Halliburton continues to expand overseas and has reached a preliminary agreement to provide services in Venezuela. If those agreements are finalized, they could become the trigger for a sharp rise in the stock price.

items.title: 「當然可能」！Jordi Visser：比特幣市值有望漲至50兆美元　「這件事」是否實現為關鍵
items.title_en: "Certainly Possible"! Jordi Visser: Bitcoin Market Cap Could Rise to $50 Trillion – Whether "This Happens" Is the Key
paras: 資深宏觀投資人暨VisserLabs創辦人Jordi Visser最新表示，隨著避險基金解除槓桿，比特幣正悄然跑贏所有主要資產類別，估值最終有望達到50兆美元！
Visser上週六(18日)在Anthony Pompliano的播客中表示，近期與AI股票相關的市場拋售，與AI本身的失敗毫無關係，並將其比作1998年長期資本管理公司(Long-Term Capital Management)的倒閉，並主張真正的壓力源來自「槓桿避險基金」，而非AI的建設浪潮。
Visser以Lone Pine Capital為例指出，截至9月漲幅曾超過40%，但隨後回吐全部收益。在Visser看來，這證明了基金運用槓桿的方式正出現結構性崩潰，而非AI增長故事存在任何缺陷。
Visser也反對將AI基礎設施公司與網路泡沫時代相提並論。他表示，CoreWeave與那個時代有根本上的不同，因其收入來自微軟、Meta和OpenAI，而非投機性的電信債務。
Visser認為，即便短期內個股估值過高，AI最終獲利仍不可避免，因為運算需求持續超過供應。
Visser指出，在標普500和那斯達克持平、債券下跌的過去四個月，比特幣一直在8.2萬至8.5萬美元之間交易。他還表示，隨著資本逃離風險較高、槓桿化的交易，比特幣正充當「安全的落腳點」。他認為，這種表現為「良好的夏普比率(Sharpe ratio)」行為，之所以突出是因為目前極少有其他資產能產生乾淨的回報。
當被問及比特幣是否可能現實地達到50兆美元的估值，Visser回答「當然可能」。他指向全球約900兆美元、目前大多缺乏流動性的資產，並表示代幣化(tokenization)最終可能將這些資產解鎖為流動、可交易的形式。
Visser主張，相同邏輯也適用於比特幣，正如馬斯克曾對SpaceX提出的論點：隨著更大規模的資金變得流動，單一資產的價值也能隨之擴展。
Visser預估，AI股票和比特幣下一波主要漲勢將出現在兩個特定時間窗口：一是本月稍晚「超大規模雲端企業(hyperscaler)」財報公布後；二是12月時許多基金將在年底停止承擔風險。
他指出，摩根士丹利機構經紀部門的AI多空部位已降至過去一年第7百分位，這表明該交易中的大部分槓桿風險已經被撤出。
Visser完全淡化9月高於預期的CPI數據，認為只要通膨讀數介於2%至3.5%之間，除非伴隨實際的就業崗位(他強調就業損失仍接近歷史低點)，否則對市場影響不大。
paras_en: Senior macro investor and VisserLabs founder Jordi Visser said that as hedge‑funds unwind leverage, Bitcoin is quietly out‑performing all major asset classes and its valuation could eventually reach $50 trillion.

Visser told Anthony Pompliano’s podcast on Saturday (the 18th) that the recent market sell‑off in AI‑related stocks has nothing to do with AI’s failure, likening it to the 1998 collapse of Long‑Term Capital Management and arguing that the real pressure comes from leveraged hedge funds, not the AI construction wave.

Citing Lone Pine Capital as an example, Visser noted that its gains had topped 40% by September before giving back all of the profit, which he says proves that the way funds use leverage is undergoing a structural breakdown rather than any flaw in the AI growth story.

Visser also rejected comparisons between AI infrastructure firms and the dot‑com bubble, saying CoreWeave is fundamentally different because its revenue comes from Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI rather than speculative telecom debt.
He believes that even if individual AI stocks are over‑valued in the short term, AI profits are inevitable because computing demand continues to outstrip supply.

Visser pointed out that over the past four months, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq have been flat and bonds have fallen, Bitcoin has traded between $82,000 and $85,000, and as capital flees higher‑risk, leveraged trades, Bitcoin is acting as a "safe landing spot"—a behavior he calls a "good Sharpe ratio" because few other assets are delivering clean returns right now.

When asked whether Bitcoin could realistically hit a $50 trillion valuation, Visser answered “certainly possible,” pointing to roughly $900 trillion of global assets that are largely illiquid and saying tokenization could eventually unlock those assets into liquid, tradable forms.
Visser argued the same logic applies to Bitcoin, echoing a point Musk made about SpaceX: as larger pools of capital become liquid, the value of a single asset can expand accordingly.

Visser forecasts the next major rally for AI stocks and Bitcoin will occur in two specific windows: later this month after the earnings of the “hyperscale” cloud giants, and in December when many funds will stop taking risk at year‑end.
He noted that Morgan Stanley’s institutional brokerage AI long‑short position has fallen to the 7th percentile of the past year, indicating that most leveraged risk in that trade has been withdrawn.

Visser downplayed September’s higher‑than‑expected CPI reading, saying that as long as inflation stays between 2% and 3.5% and isn’t accompanied by a real‑job loss (he stressed job losses remain near historic lows), its market impact will be limited.

items.title: Fable 5.5要來了？Anthropic傳開發新模型 主打理解使用者意圖
items.title_en: Is Fable 5.5 Coming? Anthropic Said to Be Developing a New Model Focused on Understanding User Intent
paras: Anthropic傳正開發一款能從模糊指令推斷使用者真實意圖的新模型，並強化推理與創意解題能力。The Information 共同創辦人 Amir Efrati 暗示，新模型可能是 Fable 5.5，但名稱與發布時間尚未獲得官方證實。
據《The Information19 日報導，一名曾使用該模型的人士透露，即使使用者的指令含糊不清，這款尚未發布的模型仍能推斷其試圖完成的目標，並展現更強的推理能力，以及更具創造性的問題解決能力。
報導並未揭露模型名稱、定價或上下文視窗等技術規格。Efrati同日在社群平台 X 發文表示：「Anthropic 是否即將發布 Fable 5.5？看起來像……」引發外界對新模型的猜測。
從執行指令走向理解意圖
目前主流大型語言模型面對模糊指令時，通常會要求使用者進一步說明，或提供較保守的通用回答。Anthropic 新模型的主要差異，在於當指令不完整或不夠精確時，能主動推斷使用者最可能想達成的目標，並據此採取行動。
若這項能力落實，使用者與 AI 助手的互動方式可能隨之改變。使用者不再需要精心設計提示詞，模型則將承擔更多理解與推斷意圖的工作，讓 AI 助手的競爭焦點從「聽懂並執行指令」，進一步轉向「理解意圖」。
在程式設計、資料分析等複雜任務中，使用者最初提出的需求往往並不完整。具備意圖推斷能力的模型，有望在僅取得粗略目標的情況下，自主拆解任務、補齊缺漏資訊並交付結果。
官方尚未公布新模型
截至 10 月 20 日，Anthropic 官方模型頁面仍僅列出四款現役模型，分別為 Claude Fable 5.1、Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 與 Claude Haiku 5.5。自 10 月 7 日發布 Haiku 5.5 以來，該公司尚未發布其他模型公告。
新模型的發布時間與實際推出安排仍未公布，是否就是外界猜測的 Fable 5.5，以及能否改變 AI 助手的互動方式，都還有待觀察。
Anthropic、OpenAI競爭升溫
與此同時，Anthropic 與 OpenAI 正圍繞新一代大型語言模型展開密集競爭。Anthropic 近期發布 Claude Opus 5.5，強調降低運行成本，使用成本較前代減少約 40%；約 90 分鐘後，OpenAI 隨即推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna，將模型呼叫價格減半。
雙方也同步升級程式開發工具的底層模型，推動 AI 程式代理朝全自動產生程式碼的方向發展。
paras_en: Anthropic is reportedly developing a new model that can infer a user’s true intent from vague commands, while also boosting reasoning and creative problem‑solving abilities. The Information co‑founder Amir Efrati hinted the model might be called Fable 5.5, though the name and release date have not been officially confirmed.

According to a report by The Information on the 19th, a person who has used the model said that even when a user’s instruction is unclear, the still‑unreleased model can deduce the goal the user is trying to achieve and demonstrate stronger reasoning and more creative problem‑solving capabilities.

The report did not disclose the model’s name, pricing, context‑window size, or other technical specifications. On the same day, Efrati posted on X, "Is Anthropic about to launch Fable 5.5? It looks like…," sparking speculation about the new model.
From Executing Commands to Understanding Intent

Current mainstream large language models typically ask users for clarification or give a conservative, generic answer when faced with ambiguous instructions. The key difference of Anthropic’s new model is that when a command is incomplete or imprecise, it proactively infers the most likely goal the user wants to achieve and acts accordingly.

If this capability materializes, the way users interact with AI assistants could change. Users would no longer need to craft meticulously designed prompts, as the model would take on more of the work of understanding and inferring intent, shifting the competitive focus of AI assistants from "understand and execute commands" to "understand intent."

In complex tasks such as programming or data analysis, users often start with incomplete requirements. A model that can infer intent could, with only a rough goal, autonomously break down the task, fill in missing information, and deliver results.
The new model has not been announced officially

As of October 20, Anthropic’s official model page lists only four active models: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5. Since the release of Haiku 5.5 on October 7, the company has not announced any additional models.
The release timing and rollout plan for the new model remain undisclosed, and it is still unclear whether it is the rumored Fable 5.5 or if it will change how AI assistants interact with users.
Anthropic and OpenAI competition heats up

At the same time, Anthropic and OpenAI are locked in an intense race over the next generation of large language models. Anthropic recently launched Claude Opus 5.5, emphasizing a roughly 40% reduction in operating costs compared with the previous generation; about 90 minutes later, OpenAI rolled out GPT‑6 Sol and Luna, halving the price per model call.
Both companies are also upgrading the underlying models of their programming‑assistant tools, pushing AI code agents toward fully automated code generation.

items.title: 記憶體長約越簽越長 Alphabet談到2035年、戴爾惠普鎖到2031年
items.title_en: Memory Supply Contracts Keep Getting Longer: Alphabet Talks 2035, Dell and HP Locked to 2031
paras: 記憶體長約越簽越長 Alphabet一口氣談到2035年 戴爾、惠普也鎖到2031年
AI資料中心記憶體供應持續吃緊，科技大廠正加快延長供應長約。據悉，惠普(HPQ-US) 、戴爾(DELL-US) 已將與美光(MU-US) 的合約延長至2031年，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 則正洽談延長至2035年。
在市場擔憂AI投資降溫之際，客戶提前鎖定供應，為記憶體產業景氣可能延續更久釋出正面訊號。
投資媒體《The Motley Fool》19日援引投資銀行KeyBanc報告指出，惠普、戴爾等美國大型伺服器製造商，已將與美光的長期供應合約延長至2031年。Alphabet也正與記憶體晶片製造商商討，將供應合約延長至2035年。
報導認為，美光近期簽署的長期供應協議，對記憶體股投資人而言，可能成為改變產業前景判斷的重要轉折。
客戶擔心晶片長期短缺、價格持續上漲，因而尋求更長期的供應保障，顯示本輪景氣熱潮可能比市場預期更持久。
不過，《The Motley Fool》也提醒，目前仍難斷言記憶體產業的繁榮一定能持續至2035年。主要客戶延長合約期限，反映的是產業強勁表現可能超出原先預期，並不代表景氣已獲得保證。
AI投資疑慮壓抑股價
三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 及美光科技(MU-US) 等主要記憶體廠，10月以來股價均明顯下跌，反映投資人對產業景氣能否延續的疑慮。
市場擔心，利率上升及獲利能力疲弱，可能增加AI企業籌資難度，進而導致資料中心投資縮減。近期AI資料中心建置熱潮，正是推升DRAM、NAND快閃記憶體與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求及價格的主要動力，若投資降溫，將對產業形成壓力。
《The Motley Fool》指出，以2027年預估淨利計算，美光目前股價對應本益比僅約5倍，凸顯市場對記憶體景氣延續性的保留態度。然而，客戶持續拉長採購合約期限，也為這種悲觀預期帶來新的變數。
美光26份長約 價格下限穩營運
美光在9月30日舉行的財報電話會議上宣布，已與客戶達成26份長期供應協議，預計到2030年，這些協議將貢獻約35%的營收。
長約除了有助掌握未來需求，部分合約設定的「價格下限」，也可為營運提供一定支撐。即使記憶體需求下滑、價格漲勢放緩，業者仍有望透過相關安排，在一定程度上穩住財務表現。
三星電子與SK海力士也在7月的第二季財報電話會議上表示，正擴大與客戶的長期供應協議，方向與美光一致。兩家公司可能在10月下旬的第三季財報電話會議上，進一步揭露長約進度。
第四季價格看漲 缺貨恐延續
短期價格展望方面，KeyBanc預估，第四季DRAM平均價格將較第三季上漲15%至20%，NAND快閃記憶體價格漲幅則將超過20%，顯示主要記憶體產品的漲價趨勢仍可能延續。
SK海力士預期，2027年DRAM供應短缺將達到歷來最嚴重程度，並持續至2030年。此外，記憶體製造商將產能集中於HBM，也被視為可能導致DRAM與NAND長期供應不足的因素。
當市場開始擔憂記憶體產業可能在2030年前後陷入低迷，部分客戶卻已將合約延長至2031年，甚至洽談延至2035年。
這些採購動向，成為評估三星、SK海力士與美光景氣續航力的重要訊號，也讓產業榮景能否超出預期，再度受到關注。
paras_en: Memory supply contracts are being extended further and further, with Alphabet discussing extensions to 2035 and Dell and HP also locked in until 2031.

AI data‑center memory supply remains tight, prompting major tech firms to accelerate the extension of long‑term supply contracts. HP (HPQ-US) and Dell (DELL-US) have already extended their agreements with Micron (MU-US) to 2031, while Alphabet, Google’s parent company (GOOGL-US), is negotiating an extension to 2035.
Amid market concerns that AI investment may be cooling, customers are locking in supply early, sending a positive signal that the memory‑industry boom could last longer than expected.

Investment media The Motley Fool cited a KeyBanc report on the 19th, noting that large U.S. server makers such as HP and Dell have extended their long‑term supply contracts with Micron to 2031. Alphabet is also in talks with the memory‑chip maker to extend its supply contract to 2035.
The report argues that Micron’s recent long‑term supply agreements could become a pivotal turning point for investors in memory stocks, potentially reshaping industry outlooks.
Customers, fearing prolonged chip shortages and rising prices, are seeking longer‑term supply guarantees, indicating that the current boom may be more durable than the market anticipates.

However, The Motley Fool cautions that it is still premature to assert that the memory industry’s prosperity will definitely continue through 2035. Extended contracts by major customers reflect stronger‑than‑expected performance, not a guaranteed boom.
AI investment concerns suppress stock prices

Since October, the shares of major memory makers Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU-US) have all fallen sharply, reflecting investor doubts about the sustainability of the industry’s upturn.

The market worries that rising interest rates and weak profitability could make fundraising harder for AI firms, potentially curbing data‑center spending. The recent surge in AI data‑center builds has been the main driver of demand and price gains for DRAM, NAND flash and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM); a cooling of investment would pressure the sector.

The Motley Fool notes that, based on a 2027 earnings estimate, Micron’s current price implies a price‑to‑earnings ratio of only about 5×, highlighting market scepticism about the durability of the memory boom. Yet, customers’ continued lengthening of purchase contracts adds a new variable to this pessimistic outlook.
Micron’s 26 Long‑Term Contracts Provide a Price Floor for Operations
At its earnings call on September 30, Micron announced that it had secured 26 long‑term supply agreements with customers, which are expected to contribute roughly 35% of revenue through 2030.

Beyond helping lock in future demand, some contracts include a “price floor,” offering operational support. Even if memory demand wanes or price growth slows, firms can rely on these arrangements to help stabilize financial performance to some extent.

Samsung and SK Hynix also said in their Q2 earnings calls in July that they are expanding long‑term supply agreements with customers, mirroring Micron’s approach. The two companies may disclose further progress on these contracts in their Q3 earnings calls slated for late October.
Q4 Price Outlook Remains Bullish, Shortages Likely to Persist

For the short‑term price outlook, KeyBanc forecasts that average DRAM prices in Q4 will rise 15%‑20% from Q3, while NAND flash prices are expected to increase by more than 20%, indicating that price‑up trends for major memory products may continue.

SK Hynix expects DRAM shortages in 2027 to reach the most severe level on record and to persist through 2030. In addition, manufacturers’ focus on HBM capacity is seen as a factor that could cause long‑term DRAM and NAND supply constraints.
When the market begins to worry that the memory industry could slump around 2030, some customers have already extended contracts to 2031 and are even discussing extensions to 2035.

These procurement trends serve as key indicators for assessing the sustainability of Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron’s business cycles, and they keep the question of whether the industry’s golden era can exceed expectations in sharp focus.

items.title: 早期投資Anthropic迎暴利！Google前CEO身價可靠這筆投資衝上800億美元
items.title_en: Early Investment in Anthropic Yields Massive Profit! Former Google CEO’s Net Worth Soars to $80 Billion from This Stake
paras: 人工智慧(AI)新創Anthropic衝刺首次公開發行(IPO)之際，持有約1%權的Google(GOOGL-US)前執行長的Eric Schmidt，在上市後的個人獲利將極為豐厚。
根據路透引述自彭博的報導，Schmidt在Anthropic的A輪募資中投入數千萬美元，但目前不清楚他是否曾出售過部分持股。
Anthropic的IPO可望為早期投資人和員工帶來巨額財富。根據該公司最近一輪募資的估值計算，Anthropic七名共同創辦人身價已各達80億美元，並因此躋身彭博億萬富豪指數，成為全球500大富豪之一。

Anthropic估值若達2兆美元 施密特身價有望逼近800億美元

根據數據公司PitchBook資料，現年71歲的Schmidt於2021年首次投資Anthropic，當時估值為4.61億美元。
投資人上周表示，Anthropic的合理估值可能落在1.8兆至2兆美元之間，若達到2兆美元，其估值將是A輪募資時的4300倍以上。然而路透上周報導，據說目前有一部分投資人正在討論下修估值至1.5兆美元，理由是上周披露的財務數據不及他們的預期。
根據彭博財富指數，若Anthropic估值達到2兆美元，這筆持股將使Schmidt身價增加約三分之一，達到將近800億美元。
即使以Anthropic最近一輪募資的9650億美元估值計算，他的身價也將增加近100億美元，而他目前的身價為575億美元。
Schmidt於2001年至2011年擔任Google執行長，之後出任母公司Alphabet執行董事長，並於2018年1月卸任。卸任後這15年來，他成為活躍的科技投資人，早期投資組合以消費者網路、軟體與金融科技為主，近年則將AI列為重要布局領域，投資標的包括Mistral AI、Reflection AI、World Labs及Anthropic。
知情人士本月稍早透露，Anthropic最快將於11月9日起的那周正式開始推介首次公開發行，目標是在美國感恩節假期前開始交易，預定最晚今年底上市。
Anthropic的主要支持者包括Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜(Amazon.com，AMZN-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)，這些企業都已投入數十億美元。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is sprinting toward its initial public offering (IPO), and Eric Schmidt, the former CEO of Google (GOOGL-US) who holds about 1% of the company, is set to reap a huge personal windfall after the listing.
According to Reuters citing Bloomberg, Schmidt put tens of millions of dollars into Anthropic’s Series A round, though it’s unclear whether he has sold any of his shares since then.

The IPO could generate massive wealth for early investors and employees. Based on the valuation from the company’s latest funding round, each of Anthropic’s seven co‑founders is now worth about $8 billion, landing them on Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index and into the world’s top‑500 richest people.

If Anthropic’s valuation reaches $2 trillion, Schmidt’s stake could push his net worth close to $80 billion. PitchBook data show the 71‑year‑old first invested in Anthropic in 2021 when the company was valued at $461 million.

Investors said last week that a reasonable valuation for Anthropic might lie between $1.8 trillion and $2 trillion, which would represent more than a 4,300‑fold increase from the Series A round. Reuters also reported that some investors are now discussing cutting the valuation down to $1.5 trillion after last week’s financial disclosures fell short of expectations.
Bloomberg’s wealth index estimates that a $2 trillion valuation would boost Schmidt’s holdings by roughly one‑third, bringing his net worth to nearly $80 billion.
Even using Anthropic’s most recent funding round valuation of $965 billion, his stake would add almost $10 billion to his wealth, taking his current net worth to about $57.5 billion.

Schmidt served as Google’s CEO from 2001 to 2011, then became chairman of its parent company Alphabet before stepping down in January 2018. In the 15 years since, he has been an active tech investor, initially focusing on consumer internet, software and fintech, and more recently making AI a key focus with investments in Mistral AI, Reflection AI, World Labs and Anthropic.

Sources close to the company said earlier this month that Anthropic could begin roadshow presentations as early as the week of November 9, aiming to start trading before the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday and to list no later than the end of the year.
Anthropic’s principal backers include Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon.com (AMZN-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US), each of which has committed tens of billions of dollars.

items.title: CoreWeave債券利率飆至15%引發AI泡沫恐慌　三大投行聯手「滅火」：市場選錯晴雨表
items.title_en: CoreWeave Bond Yield Soars to 15% Sparking AI‑Bubble Panic; Three Major Banks Team Up to ‘Extinguish’ It: Market Picked the Wrong Barometer
paras: 近期，AI基礎設施服務商CoreWeave一檔15億美元無擔保債券收益率飆升至15.6%，五年期信用違約交換(CDS)利差突破1194基點，隱含五年累計違約機率超60%，股價單週更重挫逾24%，市場擔憂這是AI資本支出周期即將斷裂的訊號，但巴克莱、高盛、摩根大通在16日至20日期間密集發聲指出，市場選錯了定價對象，也選錯了參照對象。
CoreWeave總債務約350億美元，分三層：底層是有擔保的延遲提款定期貸款(DDTL)，綁定GPU硬體與客戶合約；中層為可轉債；最上層才是無擔保票據，這檔15億美元無擔保債僅佔總債務不足5%，清算時排序最後，其15%利率定價的是「資本結構末端的殘餘風險」，而非公司整體信用或AI周期的邊際融資成本，但市場將其當作AI資本支出周期的風向球，邏輯鏈每一環都存在嚴重的代表性衰減。
巴克莱全球宏觀研究主管Ajay Rajadhyaksha將當前局面與2023年3月矽谷銀行危機並置，當時一檔40億美元區域銀行ETF被當作美國經濟風向球，結果衰退從未到來。如今一檔15億美元次級債被用來質疑上兆美元AI支出，同樣是「尾巴搖狗」。
CoreWeave今年資本支出指引350億至390億美元，僅佔五家超大规模雲端廠商同期AI支出(7250億至8000億美元)的4%-5%。即便其完全停止投資，全行業削減僅約2%至5%，不足以撼動市場。超大雲廠資金來自自由現金流，而非無擔保債市場。

高盛指出，​市場高估融資成本上升的衝擊，低估算力合約回報的改善。CoreWeave新增融資主要依賴DDTL，成本約750至1050基點，遠非15%所暗示的景象。收入方面，短期合約簽約價已達每兆瓦4000萬美元，公司近期多次提價，若新簽長約以每兆瓦1300萬美元計算，無槓桿內部收益率(IRR)約15%，高於加權平均資本成本(WACC)的11.8%，高盛也因此將評等從「中性」上調至「買入」，目標價106美元，較當時股價有約73%上行空間。
摩根大通則認為，銀行部位有擔保，項目經濟性未被改寫。截至今年上半年，銀行對CoreWeave的主要部位集中在有擔保SPV結構，多數銀行持倉低於5億美元。
軟體業分析師Samik Chatterjee重申「增持」，核心在於CoreWeave產能是在長期「照付不議」合約下預售，非先建後租。顧能(Gartner)警示的AI數據中心收入缺口，指向的是行業級「先建產能」風險，而非CoreWeave模式。
台積電10月營收超過指引上限10億美元，高算力佔比68%，艾司摩爾(ASML)訂單排至2029年。五大雲廠2027年AI支出估算超1兆美元，CoreWeave自身合約積壓約1040億美元，微軟、Meta合計佔近半。
輝達執行長黃仁勳亦公開表示，CoreWeave財務實力改善，資本成本實際下降，無需輝達額外紓困。
華爾街的「滅火」並非否認CoreWeave存在風險，自由現金流預計至2030年才轉正，執行與再融資風險真實存在，但被否認的是從這些風險到「AI資本支出周期終結」的跳躍。一擋在清算順序末端、規模不足總債務5%的工具，有效半徑止於CoreWeave無擔保融資的邊際成本，不能回答DDTL是否仍正常定價、超大客戶合約是否仍被承認為合格抵押品。
市場總是傾向抓住最小、最波動的工具當風向球，但2023年KRE與2026年CoreWeave債券的教訓相同，亦即信號真實，有效半徑卻被無限延展。真正需追蹤的是DDTL定價、SPV合同兌現節奏，以及每兆瓦收入能否跑贏資本成本。
paras_en: Recently, AI infrastructure provider CoreWeave saw the yield on its $1.5 billion unsecured bond spike to 15.6%, while the five‑year credit‑default‑swap (CDS) spread blew past 1,194 basis points, implying a cumulative five‑year default probability of over 60%. The stock fell more than 24% in a week, prompting market fears that the AI cap‑ex cycle is about to break. Barclays, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan, however, warned between Oct 16‑20 that the market has chosen the wrong pricing target and the wrong benchmark.

CoreWeave’s total debt is about $35 billion, structured in three tiers: the bottom tier is a secured delayed‑draw term loan (DDTL) tied to GPU hardware and customer contracts; the middle tier consists of convertible notes; the top tier is the unsecured paper, of which the $1.5 billion bond represents less than 5% of total debt and ranks last in liquidation priority. Its 15% rate prices the “residual risk at the bottom of the capital structure,” not the company’s overall credit or the marginal cost of AI financing, yet the market treats it as a barometer for the AI cap‑ex cycle, with every link in the logic chain suffering severe representational decay.

Barclays global macro‑research head Ajay Rajadhyaksha likened the current situation to the March 2023 Silicon Valley Bank crisis, when a $4 billion regional‑bank ETF was seen as a gauge for the U.S. economy, only for the recession to never materialise. Today a $1.5 billion sub‑prime bond is being used to question a trillion‑plus AI spend, serving the same “tail‑wagging‑the‑dog” function.

CoreWeave’s 2024 cap‑ex guidance is $35‑39 billion, just 4‑5% of the combined AI spend of the five hyperscale cloud providers ($725‑800 billion). Even if CoreWeave stopped investing entirely, the industry‑wide cut would be only about 2‑5%, insufficient to move the market. The hyperscalers fund themselves from free cash flow, not from the unsecured debt market.

Goldman Sachs argues the market over‑estimates the impact of higher financing costs and underestimates the improvement in compute‑contract returns. CoreWeave’s new financing is mainly via DDTL at a cost of roughly 750‑1,050 bps, far below the 15% implied by the bond. Revenue‑wise, short‑term contract pricing has reached $40 million per megawatt, and recent price hikes mean a new long‑term contract at $13 million per megawatt would yield an unlevered IRR of about 15%, above the weighted‑average cost of capital (WACC) of 11.8%. Consequently, Goldman upgraded its rating from “neutral” to “buy” with a target price of $106, implying roughly 73% upside from the then‑stock price.

JPMorgan sees the bank exposure as secured and believes the project economics have not been rewritten. Through the first half of the year, banks’ main positions in CoreWeave were concentrated in the secured SPV structure, with most banks holding less than $500 million each.

Software analyst Samik Chatterjee reiterated a “buy” stance, emphasizing that CoreWeave’s capacity is pre‑sold under long‑term “pay‑as‑you‑go” contracts rather than built first and leased later. Gartner’s warning about an AI data‑center revenue gap points to an industry‑wide “build‑first” capacity risk, not to CoreWeave’s model.

TSMC’s October revenue exceeded the upper guidance range by $1 billion, with high‑performance compute accounting for 68% of sales, and ASML orders now booked out to 2029. The five hyperscalers are projected to spend over $1 trillion on AI by 2027, while CoreWeave’s contract backlog sits at roughly $104 billion, with Microsoft and Meta together representing nearly half of that.
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang also publicly noted that CoreWeave’s financial position has improved, its capital cost has actually fallen, and it does not require additional rescue from NVIDIA.

Wall Street’s “fire‑fighting” does not deny CoreWeave’s risks – free cash flow is not expected to turn positive until 2030 and execution and refinancing risks are real – but it rejects the leap from those risks to an “end of the AI cap‑ex cycle.” A tool that sits at the bottom of the liquidation stack and represents less than 5% of total debt only reflects the marginal cost of CoreWeave’s unsecured financing and cannot answer whether DDTL remains properly priced or whether the hyperscale contracts still qualify as solid collateral.

Markets tend to latch onto the smallest, most volatile instruments as barometers, but the lessons from the 2023 KRE episode and the 2026 CoreWeave bond are the same: the signal may be genuine, yet its effective radius is being stretched infinitely. What truly matters is tracking DDTL pricing, SPV contract fulfilment cadence, and whether per‑megawatt revenue can outpace capital costs.

items.title: Meta豪砸AI代價浮現？Q3財報將揭示獲利壓力
items.title_en: Meta's AI Cost Surge? Q3 Earnings to Reveal Profit Pressure
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，Meta(META-US)在過去一個月因推出新產品而獲得不少正面報導，但當這家公司於週三公布財報時，看好Meta的華爾街投資人可能會再次意識到，執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)要實現他的AI願景，成本可不低。
Evercore ISI分析師Mark Mahaney警告，「我們的整體看法是，Meta對資本支出及總費用的預測將高於華爾街預期，因此我們認為，市場對Meta 2027年的獲利預估很可能會下修。」
他進一步表示，「我們的初步推測是，管理層預期2027年總費用的年增率將略低於2026年」，也就是年增約40%，而資本支出的金額增幅則將「與2026年相近」，約為700億美元。
如果Meta釋出更積極的支出展望，華爾街會如何解讀，目前仍不明朗。一方面，Meta股價在過去一個月已上漲6%，期間公司接連推出多項新產品。
Meta上週正式推出最新的先進AI模型系列Muse Wonder與Muse Wonder Full。這些模型專為多步驟推理、程式編寫，以及自主個人代理工作流程而設計。
這是Meta新成立的超級智慧實驗室Superintelligence Labs推出的首批新模型。目前，這些模型因運作速度而獲得高度評價，比較對象包括OpenAI的GPT-6，以及Anthropic的Claude Opus 5.5。這也讓市場更加看好Meta在AI熱潮中爭取大型企業客戶的能力。
與此同時，Meta於9月推出的Muse AI代理，看來也已在用戶採用方面取得良好開局。
有觀點認為，由於Meta股價持續上漲，華爾街可能忽略了公司建置AI基礎設施所需付出的成本。另一方面，市場也可能願意接受更高的支出，以支持這些備受好評的產品持續成長。
整體而言，在財報公布前，Meta的股價走勢呈現出相當複雜的局面。
Yorkville Ives合夥人Dan Ives表示，「隨著AI革命從模型發展到代理，我們仍將Meta視為值得核心持有的標的。先進AI模型搭配每日36億名活躍用戶，是少數競爭對手能夠匹敵的組合。」
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Meta (META-US) received a lot of positive coverage in the past month for launching new products, but when the company announced its earnings on Wednesday, Wall Street investors who were bullish on Meta may again realize that CEO Mark Zuckerberg's AI vision comes at a high cost.

Evercore ISI analyst Mark Mahaney warned, "Our overall view is that Meta's forecast for capital expenditures and total expenses will be higher than Wall Street expectations, so we believe the market's profit estimate for Meta in 2027 will likely be revised downward."

He further added, "Our preliminary guess is that management expects the year‑over‑year growth rate of total expenses in 2027 to be slightly lower than in 2026," which is about 40% annually, and the capital expenditure increase will be "similar to 2026," roughly $70 billion.

If Meta releases a more aggressive spending outlook, how Wall Street will interpret it remains unclear. On one hand, Meta's stock has risen 6% in the past month, during which the company rolled out several new products.

Last week, Meta officially launched its latest advanced AI model series Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. These models are designed for multi‑step reasoning, code generation, and autonomous personal agent workflows.

They are the first new models from Meta's newly established Superintelligence Labs. Currently, these models are highly praised for their speed, with competitors including OpenAI's GPT‑6 and Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5. This has made the market more optimistic about Meta's ability to win large enterprise customers in the AI boom.
Meanwhile, Meta's Muse AI agent, launched in September, appears to have had a good start in user adoption.

Some argue that because Meta's stock has continued to rise, Wall Street may overlook the costs of building AI infrastructure. On the other hand, the market may be willing to accept higher spending to support the continued growth of these highly praised products.
Overall, before the earnings announcement, Meta's stock trajectory presented a fairly complex situation.

Yorkville Ives partner Dan Ives said, "As the AI revolution moves from model development to agents, we still view Meta as a core hold. Advanced AI models paired with 3.6 billion daily active users is a combination few competitors can match."

items.title: 輝達GTC大會即將登場 英特爾3大潛在受惠機會
items.title_en: NVIDIA GTC Conference Approaches, Three Potential Benefits for Intel
paras: 輝達 (NVDA-US) 柏林 GTC 2026 大會本週登場，執行長黃仁勳預計於台灣時間週三 (21 日) 下午 5 點發表主題演講。科技媒體《Wccftech》分析指出，除了輝達自身的 AI 硬體布局，英特爾 (INTC-US) 能否在下一代產品中延續處理器合作，並進一步爭取晶圓代工與先進封裝訂單，也值得關注。
報導認為，若輝達釋出更多與英特爾合作的明確訊號，可能有助於改善市場對英特爾未來營收的預期。不過，涉及下一代 Feynman 架構的代工與封裝合作，目前仍屬市場傳聞，尚未獲得雙方正式確認。
柏林 GTC 工作坊於 10 月 20 日舉行，會議與展覽則安排在 21 至 22 日。黃仁勳的主題演講預定於柏林時間 21 日上午 11 點開始，換算台灣時間為當天下午 5 點。
處理器合作是英特爾最具實質基礎的受惠方向。
根據輝達官方規格，採用 Blackwell Ultra GPU 的 DGX B300，以及採用 Rubin GPU 的 DGX Rubin NVL8，均搭載英特爾 Xeon 6776P 處理器，其中 DGX Rubin NVL8 配置 2 顆 Xeon CPU。
這意味著，即使輝達持續擴大自研 CPU 布局，英特爾仍在部分 DGX 系統中扮演主機端處理器供應商的角色。
不過，既有產品採用 Xeon 已是公開資訊，柏林大會的觀察重點，在於這項合作是否延伸至後續產品世代。
輝達今年 3 月已揭露，下一代 Feynman 平台將納入自研 Rosa CPU。
《Wccftech》推測，部分 Feynman 架構 DGX 系統仍可能採用 Xeon，但這項配置目前尚未獲得官方確認。
晶圓代工則是另一項潛在機會。
市場傳聞指出，輝達可能採用英特爾 18A-P 或 14A 製程，製造 Feynman 世代的輸入／輸出 (I/O) 晶粒。若合作獲得證實，將有助於市場評估英特爾爭取外部代工客戶的進展，但目前製程選擇、訂單規模與生產時程均未明朗。
先進封裝方面，英特爾的 EMIB-T 與 Foveros 亦列為觀察方向，輝達未來是否可能採用其相關技術。
輝達今年持續推進 AI 平台布局，早在 3 月 16 日就已宣布，Vera Rubin 平台的 7 款晶片全面進入量產。此次柏林大會則讓市場有機會進一步了解其歐洲 AI 生態系與後續產品規劃。
對英特爾而言，這場活動的意義在於既有 CPU 合作能否延續，以及代工、封裝傳聞能否出現更具體的依據。至於英特爾能否比輝達本身獲得更大的市場效益，仍有待正式公告與實際訂單驗證。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) will hold its Berlin GTC 2026 conference this week, with CEO Jensen Huang scheduled to deliver a keynote at 5 p.m. Taiwan time on Wednesday (the 21st). Tech outlet Wccftech notes that beyond NVIDIA’s own AI hardware roadmap, it is worth watching whether Intel (INTC-US) can continue processor collaborations in next‑generation products and further win wafer‑fab and advanced‑packaging orders.

The report suggests that if NVIDIA signals more concrete cooperation with Intel, it could improve market expectations for Intel’s future revenue. However, any fab and packaging collaboration on the next‑gen Feynman architecture remains market rumor and has not been officially confirmed by either side.

The Berlin GTC workshops take place on October 20, with the conference and exhibition scheduled for the 21st‑22nd. Huang’s keynote is set to start at 11 a.m. Berlin time on the 21st, which is 5 p.m. Taiwan time that day.
Processor collaboration is the most tangible benefit avenue for Intel.

According to NVIDIA’s official specifications, the DGX B300 using the Blackwell Ultra GPU and the DGX Rubin NVL8 using the Rubin GPU both incorporate Intel Xeon 6776P processors, with the DGX Rubin NVL8 equipped with two Xeon CPUs.
This means that even as NVIDIA expands its own CPU designs, Intel still serves as the host‑side processor supplier for certain DGX systems.
However, the use of Xeon in existing products is already public; the key observation at the Berlin event is whether this cooperation will extend to future product generations.
NVIDIA disclosed in March that its next‑generation Feynman platform will include its own Rosa CPU.
Wccftech speculates that some Feynman‑based DGX systems may still use Xeon, but this configuration has not yet been officially confirmed.
Wafer fabrication represents another potential opportunity.

Market rumors indicate NVIDIA might use Intel’s 18A‑P or 14A process nodes to manufacture I/O chips for the Feynman generation. If confirmed, this would help assess Intel’s progress in winning external fab customers, though the chosen node, order size, and production timeline remain unclear.
On the advanced‑packaging front, Intel’s EMIB‑T and Foveros technologies are also being watched to see if NVIDIA may adopt them in the future.

NVIDIA continues to advance its AI platform rollout, having announced on March 16 that all seven chips of the Vera Rubin platform have entered volume production. The Berlin conference gives the market a chance to learn more about its European AI ecosystem and upcoming product plans.

For Intel, the event’s significance lies in whether existing CPU collaborations will continue and whether fab and packaging rumors will gain concrete footing. Whether Intel can capture greater market benefit than NVIDIA itself remains to be seen pending official announcements and actual orders.

items.title: AI暫時退位！能源股財報季有望領跑 獲利年增128%是科技業兩倍
items.title_en: AI Takes a Temporary Backseat! Energy Stocks Expected to Lead Earnings Season with 128% YoY Profit Growth, Double the Tech Sector
paras: 能源類股將於周二(20日)揭開財報季序幕，表現預料相當亮眼，根據FactSet彙整的最新預估，標普500指數能源類股第3季EPS預估年增128%，成長幅度約為科技業的兩倍。
不過，能源業獲利年增率可能不及第2季，當時國際油價平均每桶98美元，帶動能源企業獲利年增146%。第3季平均油價則小幅回落至每桶91美元。
儘管如此，從某些角度來看，第3季獲利仍能成長更令人意外。不久前多數分析師仍預期，伊朗戰爭將在夏季中間開始降溫，但如今戰事仍持續延燒，而且看不到明確的結束跡象。
巴隆周刊(Barron’s)報導，包括埃克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的多檔能源股，股價已來到或接近歷史高點，讓投資人對股價進一步上漲的期待也隨之提高。
目前能源企業面臨的最大問題是，打算如何運用豐沛的現金，以及是否會把握這次機會增加鑽探活動。

美國鑽井活動回溫 哈里伯頓獲利仍缺乏成長

油田服務公司哈里伯頓(Halliburton)(HAL-US)將於周二率先公布能源業財報，正好有機會滿足市場對鑽探活動的關注。
哈里伯頓是美國頁岩油產業規模最大的油田服務公司，而頁岩油占美國石油產量的最大比重。隨著美國石油生產商增加作業活動，鑽井平台數在多年下滑後終於再度回升，美國陸上鑽井平台數量今年已增加10%。
不過，油商活動仍須進一步大幅成長，才能真正帶動油田服務類股。市場預估，哈里伯頓EPS為58美分，與去年同期持平。
即使如此，哈里伯頓預估的零成長率仍優於同業。在能源產業所有次產業中，哈里伯頓所屬的油田設備與服務業是唯一預期平均EPS將年減的類別。

漲勢落後其他能源股 委內瑞拉業務成潛在利多

部分分析師認為，哈里伯頓等油田服務公司之所以值得關注，正是因為它們尚未跟上其他能源股的漲勢。
哈里伯頓也持續拓展海外業務，並已就向委內瑞拉提供服務達成初步協議。如果這些協議最終落實，可能成為推動股價開始大幅上漲的契機。
paras_en: Energy stocks will kick off the earnings season on Tuesday (the 20th), and performance is expected to be quite bright. According to the latest estimates compiled by FactSet, S&P 500 energy sector earnings per share for Q3 are projected to rise 128% year‑over‑year, roughly twice the growth rate of the technology sector.

However, the energy sector’s year‑over‑year profit growth may not match Q2, when the average international oil price was $98 per barrel, driving a 146% YoY profit increase for energy companies. In Q3 the average price slipped slightly to $91 per barrel.

Nevertheless, from some angles the Q3 profit growth remains surprisingly strong. Not long ago most analysts still expected the Iran war to start cooling in mid‑summer, but the conflict continues to flare up with no clear end in sight.
Barron’s reported that several energy stocks, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), have reached or are near historic highs, raising investors’ expectations for further price gains.
The biggest question facing energy companies now is how they will deploy abundant cash and whether they will seize this chance to boost drilling activity.

U.S. drilling activity is warming up, and Halliburton’s profit still lacks growth. Oilfield services firm Halliburton (HAL‑US) will be the first to report energy‑sector earnings on Tuesday, giving the market a chance to gauge drilling activity.

Halliburton is the largest oilfield services company in the U.S. shale oil industry, and shale oil accounts for the biggest share of U.S. oil production. As U.S. producers increase operations, the number of drilling rigs, which had been declining for years, is finally rising again, with on‑shore rigs up 10% so far this year.
Nevertheless, oil‑company activity still needs to grow substantially to truly lift oilfield‑services stocks. The market estimates Halliburton’s EPS at $0.58, flat with the same quarter last year.

Even so, Halliburton’s zero‑growth outlook is still better than its peers. Among all sub‑sectors in the energy industry, Halliburton’s oil‑field equipment and services segment is the only one expected to see an average EPS decline.

The stock’s rally lags behind other energy shares, and its Venezuela business could be a potential catalyst. Some analysts say Halliburton and other oilfield‑services firms are worth watching precisely because they have not kept pace with the gains of other energy stocks.

Halliburton continues to expand overseas and has reached a preliminary agreement to provide services in Venezuela. If those agreements are finalized, they could become the trigger for a sharp rise in the stock price.

items.title: 「當然可能」！Jordi Visser：比特幣市值有望漲至50兆美元　「這件事」是否實現為關鍵
items.title_en: "Certainly Possible"! Jordi Visser: Bitcoin Market Cap Could Rise to $50 Trillion – Whether "This Happens" Is the Key
paras: 資深宏觀投資人暨VisserLabs創辦人Jordi Visser最新表示，隨著避險基金解除槓桿，比特幣正悄然跑贏所有主要資產類別，估值最終有望達到50兆美元！
Visser上週六(18日)在Anthony Pompliano的播客中表示，近期與AI股票相關的市場拋售，與AI本身的失敗毫無關係，並將其比作1998年長期資本管理公司(Long-Term Capital Management)的倒閉，並主張真正的壓力源來自「槓桿避險基金」，而非AI的建設浪潮。
Visser以Lone Pine Capital為例指出，截至9月漲幅曾超過40%，但隨後回吐全部收益。在Visser看來，這證明了基金運用槓桿的方式正出現結構性崩潰，而非AI增長故事存在任何缺陷。
Visser也反對將AI基礎設施公司與網路泡沫時代相提並論。他表示，CoreWeave與那個時代有根本上的不同，因其收入來自微軟、Meta和OpenAI，而非投機性的電信債務。
Visser認為，即便短期內個股估值過高，AI最終獲利仍不可避免，因為運算需求持續超過供應。
Visser指出，在標普500和那斯達克持平、債券下跌的過去四個月，比特幣一直在8.2萬至8.5萬美元之間交易。他還表示，隨著資本逃離風險較高、槓桿化的交易，比特幣正充當「安全的落腳點」。他認為，這種表現為「良好的夏普比率(Sharpe ratio)」行為，之所以突出是因為目前極少有其他資產能產生乾淨的回報。
當被問及比特幣是否可能現實地達到50兆美元的估值，Visser回答「當然可能」。他指向全球約900兆美元、目前大多缺乏流動性的資產，並表示代幣化(tokenization)最終可能將這些資產解鎖為流動、可交易的形式。
Visser主張，相同邏輯也適用於比特幣，正如馬斯克曾對SpaceX提出的論點：隨著更大規模的資金變得流動，單一資產的價值也能隨之擴展。
Visser預估，AI股票和比特幣下一波主要漲勢將出現在兩個特定時間窗口：一是本月稍晚「超大規模雲端企業(hyperscaler)」財報公布後；二是12月時許多基金將在年底停止承擔風險。
他指出，摩根士丹利機構經紀部門的AI多空部位已降至過去一年第7百分位，這表明該交易中的大部分槓桿風險已經被撤出。
Visser完全淡化9月高於預期的CPI數據，認為只要通膨讀數介於2%至3.5%之間，除非伴隨實際的就業崗位(他強調就業損失仍接近歷史低點)，否則對市場影響不大。
paras_en: Senior macro investor and VisserLabs founder Jordi Visser said that as hedge‑funds unwind leverage, Bitcoin is quietly out‑performing all major asset classes and its valuation could eventually reach $50 trillion.

Visser told Anthony Pompliano’s podcast on Saturday (the 18th) that the recent market sell‑off in AI‑related stocks has nothing to do with AI’s failure, likening it to the 1998 collapse of Long‑Term Capital Management and arguing that the real pressure comes from leveraged hedge funds, not the AI construction wave.

Citing Lone Pine Capital as an example, Visser noted that its gains had topped 40% by September before giving back all of the profit, which he says proves that the way funds use leverage is undergoing a structural breakdown rather than any flaw in the AI growth story.

Visser also rejected comparisons between AI infrastructure firms and the dot‑com bubble, saying CoreWeave is fundamentally different because its revenue comes from Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI rather than speculative telecom debt.
He believes that even if individual AI stocks are over‑valued in the short term, AI profits are inevitable because computing demand continues to outstrip supply.

Visser pointed out that over the past four months, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq have been flat and bonds have fallen, Bitcoin has traded between $82,000 and $85,000, and as capital flees higher‑risk, leveraged trades, Bitcoin is acting as a "safe landing spot"—a behavior he calls a "good Sharpe ratio" because few other assets are delivering clean returns right now.

When asked whether Bitcoin could realistically hit a $50 trillion valuation, Visser answered “certainly possible,” pointing to roughly $900 trillion of global assets that are largely illiquid and saying tokenization could eventually unlock those assets into liquid, tradable forms.
Visser argued the same logic applies to Bitcoin, echoing a point Musk made about SpaceX: as larger pools of capital become liquid, the value of a single asset can expand accordingly.

Visser forecasts the next major rally for AI stocks and Bitcoin will occur in two specific windows: later this month after the earnings of the “hyperscale” cloud giants, and in December when many funds will stop taking risk at year‑end.
He noted that Morgan Stanley’s institutional brokerage AI long‑short position has fallen to the 7th percentile of the past year, indicating that most leveraged risk in that trade has been withdrawn.

Visser downplayed September’s higher‑than‑expected CPI reading, saying that as long as inflation stays between 2% and 3.5% and isn’t accompanied by a real‑job loss (he stressed job losses remain near historic lows), its market impact will be limited.

items.title: 美國年付利息突破1兆美元創新高 惠譽警告主權評等恐再降
items.title_en: U.S. Annual Interest Payments Top $1 Trillion, New High; Fitch Warns Sovereign Ratings May Be Cut Again
paras: 惠譽警告，美國若財政赤字、利息支出占收入比重及政府債務占GDP比率持續惡化，且缺乏可信的中期財政調整方案，主權評等將面臨下調壓力。
此外，已開發市場每年政府債務利息已超過3.3兆美元，隨著融資成本攀升，美國、法國與英國的債務穩定風險備受關注。
美國財政部16日公布，截至9月30日的2026財年，聯邦政府財政赤字達1.99兆美元，年增約12%，為2021年以來最大年度赤字，並連續第四年維持高檔。
公債殖利率上升帶動利息支出攀升，成為赤字擴大的關鍵因素。美國2026財年淨利息支出增加814億美元，達創紀錄的1.05兆美元，躋身政府三大支出項目。
惠譽預估，已開發市場政府債務總額年底將突破75兆美元。國際金融協會（IIF）數據顯示，即使在本輪債券拋售潮之前，富裕國家政府每年支付的利息已超過3.3兆美元，高於全球國防支出或人工智慧（AI）投資總額。
政府與科技巨頭搶資金
惠譽首席經濟學家Brian Coulton指出，這波債券殖利率飆升受到供需兩端影響。能源衝擊持續時間超出預期，改變市場對貨幣政策的判斷，也使央行更加警惕通膨的第二輪效應。
不過，除了中短期債券承壓，30年期公債殖利率也同步走高，中長期通膨預期卻大致穩定，顯示更廣泛的供需因素同樣發揮作用。
供給壓力首先來自政府赤字擴大。國際貨幣基金（IMF）10月《世界經濟展望》指出，已開發經濟體今年淨借款規模將達GDP的5.2%，創2021年以來新高。
同時，大型科技雲端企業為建置資料中心及IT基礎設施大舉融資，與主權債券爭奪資金。高盛曾估計，Google、亞馬遜、Meta、微軟及甲骨文2026年發債規模約2,500億美元，2027年將升至4,000億美元。
Coulton表示，投資需求上升、儲蓄卻未同步成長，正對美國及全球實質利率形成上行壓力。
美法英承壓 到期債務成關鍵
惠譽西歐主權評等主管Federico Barriga-Salazar指出，融資成本上升對所有已開發市場都構成壓力，尤其是債務偏高、債券集中到期規模較大的國家，美國、法國及英國首當其衝。
IMF總裁喬治艾娃近日也警告，已開發經濟體已成為債務問題上「最嚴重的違規者」。利息支出增加將壓縮財政空間，限制政府提供生活成本補助的能力。
債務期限則影響利率壓力傳導速度。英國政府債務平均剩餘期限為13.4年，法國為8.2年，意味殖利率上升對整體利息負擔的影響將逐步浮現。但法國短期到期債務占GDP達15.9%，若融資條件惡化，仍可能遭遇短期流動性衝擊。
針對法國債市動盪可能重燃歐債危機的疑慮，Barriga-Salazar指出，歐洲穩定機制、銀行業聯盟及歐洲央行支援工具，已構成遏制風險外溢的多重防線。
三項指標牽動評等
惠譽主權及超國家機構研究全球主管Ed Parker表示，評等關鍵在於高額赤字能否收斂、利息支出占財政收入比率是否持續上升，以及政府債務占GDP比率能否穩定。若指標持續惡化，又缺乏可信的財政調整方案，就可能形成降評壓力。
惠譽報告顯示，全球十大已開發經濟體10年期公債殖利率中位數，比未償債務平均利率高出161個基點，使穩定債務水準更加困難。
Parker指出，公債期限較長，為政府保留一定調整時間，但若債務比率快速攀升，又缺乏財政方案及政策執行力，公共債務可持續性風險便會上升。
以法國為例，基本財政赤字須從今年預估占GDP的2.9%降至0.4%，才能穩定債務負擔；若實際融資成本升至目前市場殖利率水準，還需額外實施相當於GDP約3.1%的財政調整。
Parker強調，美國與法國公共財政若進一步惡化，都將成為觸發評等下調的敏感因素。
paras_en: Fitch warns that if the United States’ fiscal deficit, the share of interest spending in revenue, and government debt as a percentage of GDP continue to deteriorate, and there is no credible medium‑term fiscal adjustment plan, sovereign ratings will face downward pressure.

In addition, interest payments on government debt in developed markets now exceed $3.3 trillion a year, and as financing costs rise, the debt‑stability risks of the United States, France and the United Kingdom are drawing close scrutiny.

The U.S. Treasury announced on the 16th that for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, the federal deficit reached $1.99 trillion, up about 12% year‑over‑year, the largest annual deficit since 2021 and the fourth consecutive year at a high level.

Rising bond yields have pushed interest outlays higher, becoming a key driver of the widening deficit. Net interest spending for FY 2026 rose by $81.4 billion to a record $1.05 trillion, placing it among the three largest government expenditures.

Fitch projects that total government debt in developed markets will break $75 trillion by year‑end. Data from the Institute of International Finance (IIF) show that even before the current bond‑sell‑off wave, wealthy‑nation governments already pay more than $3.3 trillion in interest each year, exceeding global defence spending or AI investment totals.
Governments and tech giants compete for capital

Fitch chief economist Brian Coulton said the surge in bond yields is driven by both supply and demand factors. A longer‑than‑expected energy shock has altered market views on monetary policy and made central banks more wary of a second‑round inflation effect.

However, beyond pressure on short‑ and medium‑term bonds, 30‑year Treasury yields have also risen, while longer‑term inflation expectations remain broadly stable, indicating that broader supply‑demand dynamics are also at play.

Supply pressure originates first from expanding fiscal deficits. The IMF’s October World Economic Outlook notes that net borrowing by developed economies this year will reach 5.2% of GDP, a high not seen since 2021.

At the same time, large cloud‑computing firms are raising massive financing to build data centres and IT infrastructure, competing with sovereign bonds for funds. Goldman Sachs estimates that Google, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft and Oracle will issue about $250 billion in debt in 2026, rising to $400 billion in 2027.
Coulton added that rising investment demand, without a matching rise in savings, is putting upward pressure on real rates in the United States and globally.
U.S., France and the U.K. under pressure as debt maturities become critical

Fitch’s Western Europe sovereign rating head Federico Barriga‑Salazar said higher financing costs are straining all developed markets, especially countries with high debt levels and large concentrations of maturing bonds, with the United States, France and the United Kingdom hit first.

IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva recently warned that developed economies have become the “most serious violators” of debt rules. Rising interest outlays will squeeze fiscal space and limit governments’ ability to provide cost‑of‑living assistance.

Debt maturity also affects how quickly rate pressure translates into higher interest burdens. The average remaining term of U.K. government debt is 13.4 years, France’s is 8.2 years, meaning the impact of rising yields on overall interest costs will unfold gradually. Yet short‑term French debt accounts for 15.9% of GDP, so a deterioration in financing conditions could still trigger a short‑term liquidity shock.

Addressing concerns that turbulence in the French bond market could reignite a Euro‑debt crisis, Barriga‑Salazar noted that the European Stability Mechanism, banking union and ECB support tools already form multiple lines of defence against risk spillovers.
Three indicators drive ratings

Fitch’s global sovereign and supranational research head Ed Parker said ratings hinge on whether large deficits can be narrowed, whether the ratio of interest spending to fiscal revenue keeps rising, and whether government debt‑to‑GDP remains stable. If these metrics keep worsening without a credible fiscal adjustment plan, rating downgrades become likely.

Fitch’s report shows that the median 10‑year yield across the world’s ten largest developed economies is 161 basis points higher than the average interest rate on outstanding debt, making debt‑stability harder to achieve.

Parker explained that longer‑dated bonds give governments more time to adjust, but if debt ratios climb quickly and there is no fiscal plan or policy execution capacity, the risk to public‑debt sustainability rises.

Using France as an example, the primary fiscal deficit must fall from an estimated 2.9% of GDP this year to 0.4% to stabilise the debt burden; if actual financing costs rise to current market yield levels, an additional fiscal adjustment equivalent to about 3.1% of GDP would be required.
Parker stressed that further deterioration in public finances in the United States or France would become a sensitive trigger for rating downgrades.

items.title: Fable 5.5要來了？Anthropic傳開發新模型 主打理解使用者意圖
items.title_en: Is Fable 5.5 Coming? Anthropic Said to Be Developing a New Model Focused on Understanding User Intent
paras: Anthropic傳正開發一款能從模糊指令推斷使用者真實意圖的新模型，並強化推理與創意解題能力。The Information 共同創辦人 Amir Efrati 暗示，新模型可能是 Fable 5.5，但名稱與發布時間尚未獲得官方證實。
據《The Information19 日報導，一名曾使用該模型的人士透露，即使使用者的指令含糊不清，這款尚未發布的模型仍能推斷其試圖完成的目標，並展現更強的推理能力，以及更具創造性的問題解決能力。
報導並未揭露模型名稱、定價或上下文視窗等技術規格。Efrati同日在社群平台 X 發文表示：「Anthropic 是否即將發布 Fable 5.5？看起來像……」引發外界對新模型的猜測。
從執行指令走向理解意圖
目前主流大型語言模型面對模糊指令時，通常會要求使用者進一步說明，或提供較保守的通用回答。Anthropic 新模型的主要差異，在於當指令不完整或不夠精確時，能主動推斷使用者最可能想達成的目標，並據此採取行動。
若這項能力落實，使用者與 AI 助手的互動方式可能隨之改變。使用者不再需要精心設計提示詞，模型則將承擔更多理解與推斷意圖的工作，讓 AI 助手的競爭焦點從「聽懂並執行指令」，進一步轉向「理解意圖」。
在程式設計、資料分析等複雜任務中，使用者最初提出的需求往往並不完整。具備意圖推斷能力的模型，有望在僅取得粗略目標的情況下，自主拆解任務、補齊缺漏資訊並交付結果。
官方尚未公布新模型
截至 10 月 20 日，Anthropic 官方模型頁面仍僅列出四款現役模型，分別為 Claude Fable 5.1、Claude Opus 5.5、Claude Sonnet 5.5 與 Claude Haiku 5.5。自 10 月 7 日發布 Haiku 5.5 以來，該公司尚未發布其他模型公告。
新模型的發布時間與實際推出安排仍未公布，是否就是外界猜測的 Fable 5.5，以及能否改變 AI 助手的互動方式，都還有待觀察。
Anthropic、OpenAI競爭升溫
與此同時，Anthropic 與 OpenAI 正圍繞新一代大型語言模型展開密集競爭。Anthropic 近期發布 Claude Opus 5.5，強調降低運行成本，使用成本較前代減少約 40%；約 90 分鐘後，OpenAI 隨即推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna，將模型呼叫價格減半。
雙方也同步升級程式開發工具的底層模型，推動 AI 程式代理朝全自動產生程式碼的方向發展。
paras_en: Anthropic is reportedly developing a new model that can infer a user’s true intent from vague commands, while also boosting reasoning and creative problem‑solving abilities. The Information co‑founder Amir Efrati hinted the model might be called Fable 5.5, though the name and release date have not been officially confirmed.

According to a report by The Information on the 19th, a person who has used the model said that even when a user’s instruction is unclear, the still‑unreleased model can deduce the goal the user is trying to achieve and demonstrate stronger reasoning and more creative problem‑solving capabilities.

The report did not disclose the model’s name, pricing, context‑window size, or other technical specifications. On the same day, Efrati posted on X, "Is Anthropic about to launch Fable 5.5? It looks like…," sparking speculation about the new model.
From Executing Commands to Understanding Intent

Current mainstream large language models typically ask users for clarification or give a conservative, generic answer when faced with ambiguous instructions. The key difference of Anthropic’s new model is that when a command is incomplete or imprecise, it proactively infers the most likely goal the user wants to achieve and acts accordingly.

If this capability materializes, the way users interact with AI assistants could change. Users would no longer need to craft meticulously designed prompts, as the model would take on more of the work of understanding and inferring intent, shifting the competitive focus of AI assistants from "understand and execute commands" to "understand intent."

In complex tasks such as programming or data analysis, users often start with incomplete requirements. A model that can infer intent could, with only a rough goal, autonomously break down the task, fill in missing information, and deliver results.
The new model has not been announced officially

As of October 20, Anthropic’s official model page lists only four active models: Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Haiku 5.5. Since the release of Haiku 5.5 on October 7, the company has not announced any additional models.
The release timing and rollout plan for the new model remain undisclosed, and it is still unclear whether it is the rumored Fable 5.5 or if it will change how AI assistants interact with users.
Anthropic and OpenAI competition heats up

At the same time, Anthropic and OpenAI are locked in an intense race over the next generation of large language models. Anthropic recently launched Claude Opus 5.5, emphasizing a roughly 40% reduction in operating costs compared with the previous generation; about 90 minutes later, OpenAI rolled out GPT‑6 Sol and Luna, halving the price per model call.
Both companies are also upgrading the underlying models of their programming‑assistant tools, pushing AI code agents toward fully automated code generation.

items.title: 記憶體長約越簽越長 Alphabet談到2035年、戴爾惠普鎖到2031年
items.title_en: Memory Supply Contracts Keep Getting Longer: Alphabet Talks 2035, Dell and HP Locked to 2031
paras: 記憶體長約越簽越長 Alphabet一口氣談到2035年 戴爾、惠普也鎖到2031年
AI資料中心記憶體供應持續吃緊，科技大廠正加快延長供應長約。據悉，惠普(HPQ-US) 、戴爾(DELL-US) 已將與美光(MU-US) 的合約延長至2031年，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 則正洽談延長至2035年。
在市場擔憂AI投資降溫之際，客戶提前鎖定供應，為記憶體產業景氣可能延續更久釋出正面訊號。
投資媒體《The Motley Fool》19日援引投資銀行KeyBanc報告指出，惠普、戴爾等美國大型伺服器製造商，已將與美光的長期供應合約延長至2031年。Alphabet也正與記憶體晶片製造商商討，將供應合約延長至2035年。
報導認為，美光近期簽署的長期供應協議，對記憶體股投資人而言，可能成為改變產業前景判斷的重要轉折。
客戶擔心晶片長期短缺、價格持續上漲，因而尋求更長期的供應保障，顯示本輪景氣熱潮可能比市場預期更持久。
不過，《The Motley Fool》也提醒，目前仍難斷言記憶體產業的繁榮一定能持續至2035年。主要客戶延長合約期限，反映的是產業強勁表現可能超出原先預期，並不代表景氣已獲得保證。
AI投資疑慮壓抑股價
三星電子(005930KS) 、SK海力士(000660KS) 及美光科技(MU-US) 等主要記憶體廠，10月以來股價均明顯下跌，反映投資人對產業景氣能否延續的疑慮。
市場擔心，利率上升及獲利能力疲弱，可能增加AI企業籌資難度，進而導致資料中心投資縮減。近期AI資料中心建置熱潮，正是推升DRAM、NAND快閃記憶體與高頻寬記憶體（HBM）需求及價格的主要動力，若投資降溫，將對產業形成壓力。
《The Motley Fool》指出，以2027年預估淨利計算，美光目前股價對應本益比僅約5倍，凸顯市場對記憶體景氣延續性的保留態度。然而，客戶持續拉長採購合約期限，也為這種悲觀預期帶來新的變數。
美光26份長約 價格下限穩營運
美光在9月30日舉行的財報電話會議上宣布，已與客戶達成26份長期供應協議，預計到2030年，這些協議將貢獻約35%的營收。
長約除了有助掌握未來需求，部分合約設定的「價格下限」，也可為營運提供一定支撐。即使記憶體需求下滑、價格漲勢放緩，業者仍有望透過相關安排，在一定程度上穩住財務表現。
三星電子與SK海力士也在7月的第二季財報電話會議上表示，正擴大與客戶的長期供應協議，方向與美光一致。兩家公司可能在10月下旬的第三季財報電話會議上，進一步揭露長約進度。
第四季價格看漲 缺貨恐延續
短期價格展望方面，KeyBanc預估，第四季DRAM平均價格將較第三季上漲15%至20%，NAND快閃記憶體價格漲幅則將超過20%，顯示主要記憶體產品的漲價趨勢仍可能延續。
SK海力士預期，2027年DRAM供應短缺將達到歷來最嚴重程度，並持續至2030年。此外，記憶體製造商將產能集中於HBM，也被視為可能導致DRAM與NAND長期供應不足的因素。
當市場開始擔憂記憶體產業可能在2030年前後陷入低迷，部分客戶卻已將合約延長至2031年，甚至洽談延至2035年。
這些採購動向，成為評估三星、SK海力士與美光景氣續航力的重要訊號，也讓產業榮景能否超出預期，再度受到關注。
paras_en: Memory supply contracts are being extended further and further, with Alphabet discussing extensions to 2035 and Dell and HP also locked in until 2031.

AI data‑center memory supply remains tight, prompting major tech firms to accelerate the extension of long‑term supply contracts. HP (HPQ-US) and Dell (DELL-US) have already extended their agreements with Micron (MU-US) to 2031, while Alphabet, Google’s parent company (GOOGL-US), is negotiating an extension to 2035.
Amid market concerns that AI investment may be cooling, customers are locking in supply early, sending a positive signal that the memory‑industry boom could last longer than expected.

Investment media The Motley Fool cited a KeyBanc report on the 19th, noting that large U.S. server makers such as HP and Dell have extended their long‑term supply contracts with Micron to 2031. Alphabet is also in talks with the memory‑chip maker to extend its supply contract to 2035.
The report argues that Micron’s recent long‑term supply agreements could become a pivotal turning point for investors in memory stocks, potentially reshaping industry outlooks.
Customers, fearing prolonged chip shortages and rising prices, are seeking longer‑term supply guarantees, indicating that the current boom may be more durable than the market anticipates.

However, The Motley Fool cautions that it is still premature to assert that the memory industry’s prosperity will definitely continue through 2035. Extended contracts by major customers reflect stronger‑than‑expected performance, not a guaranteed boom.
AI investment concerns suppress stock prices

Since October, the shares of major memory makers Samsung Electronics (005930KS), SK Hynix (000660KS) and Micron Technology (MU-US) have all fallen sharply, reflecting investor doubts about the sustainability of the industry’s upturn.

The market worries that rising interest rates and weak profitability could make fundraising harder for AI firms, potentially curbing data‑center spending. The recent surge in AI data‑center builds has been the main driver of demand and price gains for DRAM, NAND flash and high‑bandwidth memory (HBM); a cooling of investment would pressure the sector.

The Motley Fool notes that, based on a 2027 earnings estimate, Micron’s current price implies a price‑to‑earnings ratio of only about 5×, highlighting market scepticism about the durability of the memory boom. Yet, customers’ continued lengthening of purchase contracts adds a new variable to this pessimistic outlook.
Micron’s 26 Long‑Term Contracts Provide a Price Floor for Operations
At its earnings call on September 30, Micron announced that it had secured 26 long‑term supply agreements with customers, which are expected to contribute roughly 35% of revenue through 2030.

Beyond helping lock in future demand, some contracts include a “price floor,” offering operational support. Even if memory demand wanes or price growth slows, firms can rely on these arrangements to help stabilize financial performance to some extent.

Samsung and SK Hynix also said in their Q2 earnings calls in July that they are expanding long‑term supply agreements with customers, mirroring Micron’s approach. The two companies may disclose further progress on these contracts in their Q3 earnings calls slated for late October.
Q4 Price Outlook Remains Bullish, Shortages Likely to Persist

For the short‑term price outlook, KeyBanc forecasts that average DRAM prices in Q4 will rise 15%‑20% from Q3, while NAND flash prices are expected to increase by more than 20%, indicating that price‑up trends for major memory products may continue.

SK Hynix expects DRAM shortages in 2027 to reach the most severe level on record and to persist through 2030. In addition, manufacturers’ focus on HBM capacity is seen as a factor that could cause long‑term DRAM and NAND supply constraints.
When the market begins to worry that the memory industry could slump around 2030, some customers have already extended contracts to 2031 and are even discussing extensions to 2035.

These procurement trends serve as key indicators for assessing the sustainability of Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron’s business cycles, and they keep the question of whether the industry’s golden era can exceed expectations in sharp focus.
