items.title: 早期投資Anthropic迎暴利！Google前CEO身價可靠這筆投資衝上800億美元
items.title_en: Early Investment in Anthropic Yields Massive Profit! Former Google CEO’s Net Worth Soars to $80 Billion from This Stake
paras: 人工智慧(AI)新創Anthropic衝刺首次公開發行(IPO)之際，持有約1%權的Google(GOOGL-US)前執行長的Eric Schmidt，在上市後的個人獲利將極為豐厚。
根據路透引述自彭博的報導，Schmidt在Anthropic的A輪募資中投入數千萬美元，但目前不清楚他是否曾出售過部分持股。
Anthropic的IPO可望為早期投資人和員工帶來巨額財富。根據該公司最近一輪募資的估值計算，Anthropic七名共同創辦人身價已各達80億美元，並因此躋身彭博億萬富豪指數，成為全球500大富豪之一。

Anthropic估值若達2兆美元 施密特身價有望逼近800億美元

根據數據公司PitchBook資料，現年71歲的Schmidt於2021年首次投資Anthropic，當時估值為4.61億美元。
投資人上周表示，Anthropic的合理估值可能落在1.8兆至2兆美元之間，若達到2兆美元，其估值將是A輪募資時的4300倍以上。然而路透上周報導，據說目前有一部分投資人正在討論下修估值至1.5兆美元，理由是上周披露的財務數據不及他們的預期。
根據彭博財富指數，若Anthropic估值達到2兆美元，這筆持股將使Schmidt身價增加約三分之一，達到將近800億美元。
即使以Anthropic最近一輪募資的9650億美元估值計算，他的身價也將增加近100億美元，而他目前的身價為575億美元。
Schmidt於2001年至2011年擔任Google執行長，之後出任母公司Alphabet執行董事長，並於2018年1月卸任。卸任後這15年來，他成為活躍的科技投資人，早期投資組合以消費者網路、軟體與金融科技為主，近年則將AI列為重要布局領域，投資標的包括Mistral AI、Reflection AI、World Labs及Anthropic。
知情人士本月稍早透露，Anthropic最快將於11月9日起的那周正式開始推介首次公開發行，目標是在美國感恩節假期前開始交易，預定最晚今年底上市。
Anthropic的主要支持者包括Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、亞馬遜(Amazon.com，AMZN-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)，這些企業都已投入數十億美元。
paras_en: AI startup Anthropic is sprinting toward its initial public offering (IPO), and Eric Schmidt, the former CEO of Google (GOOGL-US) who holds about 1% of the company, is set to reap a huge personal windfall after the listing.
According to Reuters citing Bloomberg, Schmidt put tens of millions of dollars into Anthropic’s Series A round, though it’s unclear whether he has sold any of his shares since then.

The IPO could generate massive wealth for early investors and employees. Based on the valuation from the company’s latest funding round, each of Anthropic’s seven co‑founders is now worth about $8 billion, landing them on Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index and into the world’s top‑500 richest people.

If Anthropic’s valuation reaches $2 trillion, Schmidt’s stake could push his net worth close to $80 billion. PitchBook data show the 71‑year‑old first invested in Anthropic in 2021 when the company was valued at $461 million.

Investors said last week that a reasonable valuation for Anthropic might lie between $1.8 trillion and $2 trillion, which would represent more than a 4,300‑fold increase from the Series A round. Reuters also reported that some investors are now discussing cutting the valuation down to $1.5 trillion after last week’s financial disclosures fell short of expectations.
Bloomberg’s wealth index estimates that a $2 trillion valuation would boost Schmidt’s holdings by roughly one‑third, bringing his net worth to nearly $80 billion.
Even using Anthropic’s most recent funding round valuation of $965 billion, his stake would add almost $10 billion to his wealth, taking his current net worth to about $57.5 billion.

Schmidt served as Google’s CEO from 2001 to 2011, then became chairman of its parent company Alphabet before stepping down in January 2018. In the 15 years since, he has been an active tech investor, initially focusing on consumer internet, software and fintech, and more recently making AI a key focus with investments in Mistral AI, Reflection AI, World Labs and Anthropic.

Sources close to the company said earlier this month that Anthropic could begin roadshow presentations as early as the week of November 9, aiming to start trading before the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday and to list no later than the end of the year.
Anthropic’s principal backers include Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Amazon.com (AMZN-US), Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Microsoft (MSFT-US), each of which has committed tens of billions of dollars.

法國各城市有數千人與警方發生衝突，部分商店遭到洗劫，造成近年來最嚴重社會動亂之一。暴力事件進一步加大法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）政治壓力。在 2027 年任期結束前，他的施政已因日益高漲的社會不滿情緒而陷入愈發嚴重的停滯。
由於法國政府公債（OAT）表現落後，而透過信用違約交換（CDS）為法國主權債務投保的成本也升至多年高點，法國公債與德國聯邦公債（Bund）之間的利差進一步擴大，對歐元構成直接的基本面壓力。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.3%，至 1.1210 美元。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 表示，「法國的社會局勢可能帶來一種和平且具宣洩效果的改變，例如透過提高退休年齡來推動緊縮政策，前提是民主制度能夠維持穩定。然而，真正可能引發轉變的 2027 年大選，對大多數交易員而言仍太遙遠。他們更擔心的是未來幾週的局勢發展。」
他進一步指出，「只要電視畫面持續出現混亂景象，市場就傾向於賣出歐元，並推高法國主權債務利差。如果法國出現存款外流，將可能促使歐洲央行（ECB）介入，而這很可能進一步削弱歐元。」
法國 10 年期公債殖利率週一大幅上升，債券拋售壓力也蔓延至美國市場。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 4.5 個基點，來到 5.145%。對利率政策較為敏感的 2 年期公債殖利率則上升 4 個基點，來到 4.776%。
日元走弱 加幣走強
日元走弱，美元兌日元升至 158.53。
日本當局先前已與美國釋出聯合警告訊號，外匯交易部門對東京當局可能在目前價位進場干預匯市，仍保持高度警戒。
日本銀行（BoJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在公開談話中表示，日本的基礎通膨正穩步接近央行設定的 2% 目標。
植田的發言進一步強化市場預期：央行仍將循序漸進地推動貨幣政策正常化。因此，利率市場持續關注日銀今年稍晚可能採取的貨幣政策調整。
另一方面，印尼盾終於停止連續四個交易日的跌勢。在這波下跌期間，印尼盾一度貶至 1 美元兌 18,063 印尼盾，創下近三個月來最低。
這波拋售潮起因是 MSCI 提議調降印尼股票市場評級，理由是印尼市場長期存在外資進入不易及公司治理方面的疑慮。
這項提議引發印尼雅加達綜合指數單日暴跌 11.6%，創下 1998 年亞洲金融風暴以來最大單日跌幅。
其他市場方面，加拿大幣兌美元走強，美元兌加拿大元跌至 1.4110。
加拿大消費者通膨加速，提升了市場對加拿大央行(BoC)可能採取較強硬貨幣政策的預期。
根據加拿大統計局公布數據，加拿大 9 月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率為 3.1%，低於經濟學家預估的 3.2%，但高於 8 月的 3.0%。
此外，這也是加拿大 CPI 連續三個月上升後，首次超出加拿大央行設定的 1% 至 3% 通膨目標區間。
本次 CPI 上升主要受到能源價格推動。能源價格年增 19%，其中汽油價格更大幅上漲 27.8%。
加拿大央行總裁 Tiff Macklem 已表示，通膨可能進一步上升。儘管他也指出，目前還沒有太多證據顯示，價格壓力已經擴散至其他商品與服務。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Monday (the 19th), mainly driven by a falling euro and a renewed wave of selling in the U.S. bond market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 102. Earlier, the index had posted its first weekly decline in nearly five weeks, as expectations for near‑term Fed rate hikes cooled slightly.
France in Turmoil
Market participants in the U.S. and global FX markets are watching the escalating situation in France closely.

As the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, France saw massive violent protests over the weekend, with citizens angry about soaring living costs and underfunded public services, while the country also faces a fiscal crisis.

Thousands clashed with police in cities across France, some shops were looted, creating one of the most severe social upheavals in recent years. The violence adds political pressure on President Emmanuel Macron, whose agenda is increasingly stalled by rising social discontent ahead of the end of his term in 2027.

Because French government bonds (OAT) have underperformed and the cost of insuring French sovereign debt via credit‑default swaps (CDS) has risen to multi‑year highs, the spread between French OATs and German Bunds has widened, putting direct fundamental pressure on the euro.
The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1210.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “France’s social situation could lead to a peaceful, venting‑type change, such as raising the retirement age to push a tightening agenda, provided the democratic system remains stable. However, the real catalyst – the 2027 election – is still too far away for most traders. They are more concerned about how the situation develops over the next few weeks.”

He added, “As long as TV screens keep showing chaos, markets tend to sell euros and push French sovereign spreads higher. If France sees capital outflows, the European Central Bank may step in, which could further weaken the euro.”
French 10‑year bond yields jumped sharply on Monday, and bond‑selling pressure spread to the U.S. market.
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose 4.5 basis points to 5.145%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbed 4 basis points to 4.776%.
Yen Weakens, Canadian Dollar Strengthens
The yen weakened as the dollar rose to ¥158.53.
Japanese authorities have previously signaled a joint warning with the United States, and the FX trading desk remains on high alert for possible intervention by Tokyo officials at current levels.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said in a public remarks that Japan’s core inflation is steadily moving toward the central bank’s 2% target.
Ueda’s comments reinforced market expectations that the BOJ will continue a gradual normalization of monetary policy, keeping rate markets focused on potential policy adjustments later this year.
On the other hand, the Indonesian rupiah finally halted a four‑day losing streak. During the decline it had slipped to IDR 18,063 per dollar, a three‑month low.
The sell‑off was sparked by an MSCI proposal to downgrade Indonesia’s equity market rating, citing long‑standing difficulties for foreign investors and corporate‑governance concerns.
The proposal triggered an 11.6% single‑day plunge in the Jakarta Composite Index, the biggest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis.
In other markets, the Canadian dollar rose against the dollar, with USD/CAD slipping to 1.4110.
Canadian consumer inflation accelerated, raising expectations that the Bank of Canada may adopt a tighter policy stance.
Statistics Canada reported that September’s CPI rose 3.1% year‑over‑year, below the 3.2% forecast but above August’s 3.0%.
It also marked the first time in three months that Canada’s CPI moved above the BoC’s 1%‑3% target range.
The CPI increase was mainly driven by energy prices, which rose 19% year‑over‑year, with gasoline jumping 27.8%.
Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said inflation could rise further, though he noted there is still limited evidence that price pressures have spread to other goods and services.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢持續流出 重貶1.07角收32.445元
items.title_en: TWD: Hot Money Continues to Flow Out, Depreciates 0.107 to Close at 32.445
paras: 台北金融市場今(19) 日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
觀察台股法人動態，三大法人今日資金操作分歧明顯。外資及陸資延續偏空態度，單日賣超高達767.43億元，寫下連續9個交易日賣超紀錄；自營商也站在賣方，賣超362.63億元；僅投信法人獨撐大局，逆勢買超230.51億元，展現強烈護盤意願。
今日台股籌碼面持續出現調節，導致大盤開盤即遭重挫，盤中最低下探46170點，考驗季線支撐，所幸尾盤台積電等半導體族群拉回平盤，帶動指數跌幅收斂。
匯市方面，新台幣兌美元開盤價為32.36元，隨後受外資強勁匯出買賣盤衝擊，匯價一路下探，早盤最高僅達32.36元，盤中最低重摔至32.572元。面對外資短時間大幅撤離，中央銀行盤中罕見緊急發布聲明穩固信心，並適時進場拋匯提供美元流動性。終場台北外匯市場新台幣收在32.445元，貶值1.07角；成交金額則擴大至28.31億美元。
元太外匯市場新台幣收盤價則為32.468元，貶值1.2角，成交金額為10.22億美元。兩大匯市合計成交金額衝高至38.53億美元，顯示市場交投極為熱絡且多空對峙激烈。
paras_en: Taipei's financial markets saw a repeat of the "stock‑currency double kill" today (19th) as US equity volatility and rising global risk‑off sentiment prompted foreign investors to pull out large amounts of capital. The three major institutional investors collectively sold a net 89.954 billion TWD of Taiwanese equities, and the weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Meanwhile, under heavy net outflows in the foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar, briefly hitting a low of 32.572 TWD per USD before closing down 0.107 to 32.445, with the two major FX markets reporting a combined outflow of $3.853 billion.

Looking at the activity of Taiwan's institutional investors, today's fund flows showed a clear divergence. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors maintained a bearish stance, net selling a record 76.743 billion TWD in a single day, marking the ninth consecutive trading day of net outflows. Proprietary traders also sold, netting 36.263 billion TWD. Only investment trusts stood on the buying side, net purchasing 23.051 billion TWD, demonstrating a strong willingness to support the market.

The market's capital structure continued to adjust today, causing the index to tumble sharply at the open and dip to a intraday low of 46,170 points, testing the seasonal (quarterly) support line. Fortunately, semiconductor stocks such as TSMC rallied in the closing minutes, pulling the index back toward the flat line and narrowing the overall decline.

In the FX market, the TWD opened at 32.36 per USD but was quickly pressured lower by strong foreign outflows, falling to a low of 32.572 during the session. Facing a rapid, large‑scale withdrawal of foreign capital, the central bank issued a rare emergency statement mid‑session to steady confidence and intervened by selling dollars to provide liquidity. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.445, a depreciation of 0.107, with transaction volume expanding to $2.831 billion.

The Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.468, a depreciation of 0.12, with a transaction volume of $1.022 billion. Combined, the two major FX markets saw total turnover rise to $3.853 billion, indicating extremely active trading and fierce battles between buyers and sellers.

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 人工智慧浪潮助推 馬來西亞9月出口額創逾5年新高
items.title_en: AI Wave Boosts Malaysia's September Export Value to Over Five-Year High
paras: 受惠於全球人工智慧(AI)浪潮與資料中心建置帶動的半導體及電子產品需求，馬來西亞今年9月外貿展現強勁成長力道，出口額刷新逾5年來最高紀錄。
根據馬來西亞統計局(DOSM)與投資貿易暨工業部(MITI)公布的最新數據，馬來西亞9月出口額達2,151億令吉(約合450億美元)，年增54.5%，表現遠超出《路透》調查預期的44.6%及《彭博》預估的39.9%。
在進出口同步雙位數成長帶動下，9月總貿易額年增53.7%至3,965億令吉。進口額則年增52.7%至1,814億令吉，高於市場預期的39%，9月貿易順差擴大約65%至337億令吉，高於預期的316億令吉。
統計局資料顯示，進口擴張主要由生產輸入端需求強勁所推升，其中中間財進口大增69.6%至921億令吉，資本財與消費財進口亦分別成長20.9%及18.2%。
從主要出口商品來看，占總出口半數以上的電子與電器產品(E&E)9月出口額年增率高達68%至69.2%，創下單月歷史新高。包含半導體測試儀器在內的光學與科學設備出口額亦同步登頂。
出口市場方面，對台灣出口年增率高達175.2%(成長超過一倍)，對美國出口成長89.9%，對中國出口則成長22.1%。相對地，受棕櫚油出口減少拖累，農業出口年減5.7%。
針對未來外貿展望，馬來西亞投資貿工部在官方聲明中特別警示：「馬來西亞的貿易表現仍面臨主要經濟體貿易政策轉變及地緣政治緊張局勢帶來的不確定性。」
MITI 分析，尤其是中東地區持續的衝突可能打亂全球貿易流動並加劇成本壓力。MITI 表示未來將持續「評估相關發展、加強市場多元化、擴大進入高成長市場，並協助馬來西亞出口商進行調整」，以增強外貿抗風險能力。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global artificial intelligence (AI) wave and the demand for semiconductors and electronic products driven by data‑center construction, Malaysia’s foreign trade showed strong growth in September, with export value reaching a record high not seen in more than five years.

According to the latest data released by Malaysia’s Department of Statistics (DOSM) and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), September export value hit RM215.1 billion (about US$45 billion), up 54.5% year‑on‑year, far exceeding Reuters’ forecast of 44.6% and Bloomberg’s estimate of 39.9%.

With both imports and exports posting double‑digit growth, total trade in September rose 53.7% year‑on‑year to RM396.5 billion. Imports increased 52.7% to RM181.4 billion, above the market’s 39% expectation, and the trade surplus widened about 65% to RM33.7 billion, higher than the anticipated RM31.6 billion.

Statistics show that the import expansion was mainly driven by strong demand for production inputs, with intermediate goods imports surging 69.6% to RM92.1 billion, while capital goods and consumer goods imports grew 20.9% and 18.2% respectively.

Looking at major export commodities, electronic and electrical (E&E) products, which account for more than half of total exports, posted a year‑on‑year growth of 68% to RM69.2 billion, setting a new monthly historical high. Exports of optical and scientific equipment, including semiconductor testing instruments, also hit record levels.

In terms of export markets, shipments to Taiwan jumped 175.2% year‑on‑year (more than double), to the United States grew 89.9%, and to China rose 22.1%. Conversely, agricultural exports fell 5.7% year‑on‑year due to a drop in palm‑oil shipments.

Regarding the outlook, MITI warned in an official statement that “Malaysia’s trade performance still faces uncertainty from major economies’ shifting trade policies and heightened geopolitical tensions.”

MITI analysis notes that ongoing conflicts in the Middle East could disrupt global trade flows and increase cost pressures. It said Malaysia will continue to “assess developments, strengthen market diversification, expand entry into high‑growth markets, and help exporters adjust,” to boost the resilience of its foreign trade.

美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)主席沃什雖對美國經濟韌性表示樂觀，且稱受益人工智能推動，並向其他領域擴展的投資熱潮，正引發短期需求衝擊，從而對通脹形成上行壓力，但拒絕透露關於今年剩餘時間的會議上可能採取的行動，使得美元承壓；此外，日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男表示，確保基礎通脹率穩定在BOJ 2%的通脹目標附近正變得越來越重要，且據路透公布一項調查顯示，隨著中東衝突推動能源價格上漲的影響正逐步傳導至家庭，日本9月核心消費者通脹率可能自12月以來首次超過BOJ 2%的目標，另外美國財政部次長Erin Browne指出，日本已不再面臨持續十餘年的通縮環境，其匯率水平與貨幣政策必須相應調整，並隨著日本投資人截至10月10日當週連續第四週淨賣出外國債券，延續了撤離海外債市的趨勢，提供日圓支撐，令美元兌日圓下降至157.67低點。

隨後據美國官方公布9月數據顯示，工業生產及製造業產出分別成長0.7%及0.3%，且衡量企業資源利用程度的產能利用率升至76.9%，另外進口及出口物價月率漲幅分別為1.1%及2.2%，皆超過市場預期，且進口物價同比上漲8.1%，漲幅為2022年7月以來最大，這進一步表明，隨著中東衝突持續，美國國內通脹壓力正在加劇，推動美元兌日圓走升至158.33高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.10-30，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲疲軟的就業數據表現，促使投資人下調對澳洲央行(RBA)今年第五次加息的押注，拖累澳幣走勢，但相較於紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)首席經濟學家康韋在接受彭博新聞採訪時稱下一次利率調整一切皆有可能，隨著調期市場數據顯示，RBNZ在10月28日將利率上調25個基點概率為86%，為紐元提供支撐，而且國際貨幣基金(IMF)預計歐洲央行(ECB)於2026年至少加息25個基點，提振歐元兌美元觸及1.1269高點。
據歐盟統計局公布歐元區9月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)月率及年率分別上升0.6%及3.8%，符合預期，但8月未經季節性調整貿易數據意外錄得逆差161億歐元，且據IMF指出法國借貸成本短期內仍屬可控，但財政整頓壓力恐將加大，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1206低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1260-80。
◆GBP/USD

週五英國央行(BOE)總裁貝利於出席國際金融協會(IIF)時表示英國通脹率高於目標水平，但迄今為止，能源價格飆升似乎對英國物價廣泛影響有限，令英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3263低點；隨後美國FED主席沃什未對美國強勁的CPI及PPI數據置評，使得10月FED加息的概率也因沃什的言論而下降，相較於路透調查的多數經濟學家預測，BOE將於11月將指標利率上調至4.0%，這將是該行三年多來的首次加息，激勵英鎊兌美元漲至三週高點1.3371。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3290-1.3310，阻力於1.3370-90。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed optimism about the resilience of the U.S. economy and said that the investment boom spurred by artificial‑intelligence advances and its spill‑over into other sectors is creating short‑term demand pressure that could push inflation higher. He declined to reveal what actions might be taken at the remaining meetings this year, leaving the dollar under pressure. Meanwhile, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it is becoming increasingly important to keep core‑inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target, and a Reuters poll shows that rising energy prices from the Middle‑East conflict are gradually passing through to households. Japan’s core CPI for September could exceed the BOJ’s 2% goal for the first time since December. U.S. Treasury Deputy Secretary Erin Browne added that Japan is no longer in a decade‑long deflationary environment, so its exchange‑rate level and monetary policy must adjust. Japanese investors have sold foreign bonds for the fourth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 10, continuing the pull‑out from overseas bond markets, which supports the yen and pushed USD/JPY down to a low of 157.67.

Subsequent U.S. official data for September showed industrial production up 0.7% and manufacturing output up 0.3%, while capacity utilization rose to 76.9%. Import and export prices rose 1.1% and 2.2% month‑over‑month, both above expectations, and import prices jumped 8.1% year‑over‑year – the biggest rise since July 2022. The figures indicate that, as the Middle‑East conflict persists, domestic inflation pressure in the United States is intensifying, driving the dollar up to a high of 158.33 against the yen. The market expects resistance for USD/JPY around 158.10‑30 and support around 157.30‑50.
EUR/USD

Weak Australian employment data led investors to downgrade bets on a fifth RBA rate hike this year, weighing on the Aussie dollar. By contrast, Reserve Bank of New Zealand chief economist Michael Baker told Bloomberg that any outcome is possible for the next rate move, and market data show an 86% probability that the RBNZ will raise rates by 25 basis points on Oct. 28, supporting the kiwi. The International Monetary Fund also projects that the European Central Bank will lift rates by at least 25 basis points in 2026, helping the euro climb to a high of 1.1269 against the dollar.

Euro‑area CPI data released by Eurostat showed the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices rising 0.6% month‑over‑month and 3.8% year‑over‑year in September, in line with expectations. However, seasonally‑adjusted trade data for August unexpectedly posted a €16.1 billion deficit. The IMF noted that France’s short‑term borrowing costs remain manageable, but fiscal‑adjustment pressure could increase, pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1206. The market expects support for the euro around 1.1190‑1.1210 and resistance around 1.1260‑1.1280.
GBP/USD

On Friday, Bank of England Governor Andrew Holmes told the International Finance Forum that UK inflation remains above target, but so far the surge in energy prices has had limited broad‑based impact on prices, leaving the pound flat at a low of 1.3263 against the dollar. Later, Fed Chair Jerome Powell did not comment on the strong U.S. CPI and PPI numbers, reducing the perceived probability of an October Fed hike. Most Reuters‑surveyed economists now expect the BOE to raise its policy rate to 4.0% in November – the first hike in more than three years – which could lift GBP/USD to a three‑week high of 1.3371. The market projects support for the pound around 1.3290‑1.3310 and resistance around 1.3370‑1.3390.

items.title: 台幣逼近32.5元還會貶？外銀看好強勁出口支撐 年底反攻31.5元
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Near 32.5 per Dollar – Will It Depreciate Further? Foreign Banks See Strong Export Support, Expect a Rebound to 31.5 by Year‑End
paras: 分析師表示，全球市場對人工智慧（AI）交易的疑慮引發新台幣走弱，卻掩蓋了台灣經濟的基本韌性；穩健的經濟基本面可望支撐新台幣在年底前回升。
儘管新台幣近期承受沉重壓力，華僑銀行與荷蘭國際集團（ING）仍預期，新台幣將分別回升至兌1美元31.60元與31.50元，較目前水準升值約2%。
這些預測的依據，是台灣強勁的經濟成長與經常帳順差。儘管市場對AI股高估值的疑慮持續推動資金外流，短期壓抑匯率，分析師預期，未來幾個月貿易基本面的支撐終將占上風。
三菱日聯銀行（MUFG）亞洲全球市場研究主管Lin Li表示：「創紀錄的貿易順差與AI相關出口，持續為新台幣提供基本支撐。但外資證券投資流出、對外投資，以及美元與新台幣之間龐大的利差，目前正創造美元需求，抵銷這些支撐。」
她預期，新台幣年底前將升至兌1美元31.8元，並在2027年6月底進一步升至30.9元。
出口與順差強勁 外資撤出台股形成拉鋸
受全球先進晶片需求空前強勁帶動，台灣經常帳順差在2025年底達到近700億美元的歷史新高，近幾個月則溫和收窄。同時，政府將全年經濟成長率預測上修至逾10%，台灣可望迎來2010年以來首次雙位數成長。
不過，這些基本面優勢正與外資撤離潮相互拉鋸。外資周四賣超台股新台幣3,026億元（約93億美元），創單日新高，推動新台幣逼近今年以來兌1美元約32.50元的低點。
雖然分析師不認為這個價位是央行必須捍衛的防線，但仍密切關注，視其為央行可接受匯率區間的重要參考。
ING大中華區首席經濟學家宋林表示：「央行將試圖讓新台幣維持相對區間震盪。我不認為存在必須守住的明確防線，但今年以來，31.5至32.5元似乎一直是央行可以接受的區間。」
道富銀行亞太區總體策略師Jiuk Choi認為，央行更可能著重降低匯率波動，而非鎖定特定價位。他表示：「話雖如此，我們認為美元兌新台幣32.4至32.5元是重要區間，因為這是2026年以來的高點。」
油價與利差添壓力 中期仍看升
除了科技業疑慮，台灣作為能源進口國，偏高的原油價格也為新台幣增添壓力。此外，美國10年期公債殖利率較台灣同天期公債高出約300個基點，具吸引力的利差持續支撐美元普遍走強，壓抑區域貨幣表現。
LGT私人銀行外匯與利率專家Trang Le表示：「短期逆風包括外資撤出台股，以及聯準會立場偏鷹帶動美元走強。」
她指出：「即便如此，強勁的出口動能、穩健的對外收支，以及AI驅動的半導體景氣循環，仍使新台幣中期走勢偏向升值。我們預期，匯率波動將是主軸，而非持續走弱。」
科技財報成下一個匯率關鍵
匯市交易員正關注主要半導體製造商的財報，策略師視其為牽動跨境股市資金流向與匯率波動的下一個關鍵因素。台積電周四公布優於預期的營收展望，卻未能完全平息市場對整體AI基礎建設擴張的疑慮。
道富銀行的Choi表示：「接下來公布的全球科技業財報，可能加劇新台幣波動，尤其市場對AI相關資本支出、獲利能力及中國競爭的敏感度已升高。」
他認為，AI交易疑慮仍可能讓新台幣短期進一步走弱，但預期年底前將回升至兌1美元31.80元。
他表示：「我們認為，新台幣是對沖美元走強的最佳貨幣之一，因為資本與經常帳資金流仍然強勁，而且新台幣也是新興市場中波動率最低的貨幣之一。」
paras_en: Analysts say that global concerns over artificial‑intelligence (AI) trading have weakened the New Taiwan dollar, but this masks the underlying resilience of Taiwan’s economy; a solid economic foundation is expected to support a rebound of the currency before year‑end.

Even though the New Taiwan dollar has been under heavy pressure recently, both OCBC and ING forecast that it will recover to about NT$31.60 per US$1 and NT$31.50 per US$1 respectively, roughly a 2% appreciation from current levels.

These forecasts are based on Taiwan’s strong economic growth and current‑account surplus. Although market worries about over‑valued AI stocks continue to drive capital outflows and suppress the exchange rate in the short term, analysts expect the trade fundamentals to ultimately prevail in the coming months.

Lin Li, head of Asian Global Markets Research at MUFG, said: “Record‑high trade surpluses and AI‑related exports continuously provide fundamental support for the New Taiwan dollar. Yet foreign‑security outflows, outbound investment and the huge interest‑rate differential between the dollar and the New Taiwan dollar are currently creating dollar demand that offsets those supports.”
She projects the New Taiwan dollar will rise to NT$31.8 per US$1 by year‑end and further to NT$30.9 by the end of June 2027.
Strong exports and surplus, foreign‑capital pull‑out creates a tug‑of‑war in Taiwan equities

Fueled by unprecedented demand for advanced chips worldwide, Taiwan’s current‑account surplus is set to hit a historic high of nearly US$70 billion by the end of 2025, though it has narrowed modestly in recent months. At the same time, the government has lifted its full‑year growth forecast to above 10%, positioning Taiwan for its first double‑digit expansion since 2010.

However, these fundamental strengths are being contested by a wave of foreign‑capital outflows. On Thursday foreign investors sold NT$3,026 billion (about US$9.3 billion) of Taiwan equities, a single‑day record, pushing the New Taiwan dollar toward this year’s low of roughly NT$32.50 per US$1.
While analysts do not view this level as a hard floor the central bank must defend, they are watching it closely as an important reference for the exchange‑rate band the bank may tolerate.

Song Lin, chief economist for Greater China at ING, said: “The central bank will try to keep the New Taiwan dollar within a relative range. I don’t see a clear floor that must be defended, but since the start of the year the NT$31.5‑NT$32.5 band has seemed acceptable to the central bank.”

Jiuk Choi, global‑strategy head for Asia‑Pacific at State Street, believes the central bank is more likely to focus on reducing volatility rather than anchoring a specific level. He added: “That said, we see NT$32.4‑NT$32.5 per US$1 as a key zone because it marks the high point reached in 2026.”
Oil prices and interest‑rate spreads add pressure; medium‑term outlook still upward

Beyond tech‑sector concerns, Taiwan’s status as an energy‑importing nation means high crude‑oil prices add further pressure on the New Taiwan dollar. In addition, the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield is about 300 basis points higher than Taiwan’s comparable bond, and the attractive spread continues to underpin a broadly strong dollar, suppressing regional currencies.
Trang Le, FX and rates specialist at LGT Private Bank, said: “Short‑term headwinds include foreign‑capital outflows from Taiwan equities and a hawkish Fed stance that is bolstering the dollar.”

She noted: “Even so, strong export momentum, solid external balances and an AI‑driven semiconductor cycle still tilt the medium‑term New Taiwan dollar trend toward appreciation. We expect exchange‑rate volatility to be the main driver, not a continued weakening.”
Tech earnings become the next exchange‑rate catalyst

FX traders are watching earnings reports from major semiconductor manufacturers, which strategists see as the next key factor influencing cross‑border equity flows and currency moves. TSMC’s Thursday earnings outlook beat expectations, but did not fully allay market concerns about the broader AI‑infrastructure expansion.

State Street’s Choi said: “The upcoming global tech earnings season could amplify New Taiwan dollar volatility, especially as market sensitivity to AI‑related capex, profitability and competition from China has risen.”
He believes AI‑trading worries could still push the New Taiwan dollar lower in the short term, but expects a rebound to NT$31.80 per US$1 by year‑end.

He added: “We see the New Taiwan dollar as one of the best hedges against a strong dollar because capital and current‑account flows remain robust, and the New Taiwan dollar is also among the least volatile currencies in emerging markets.”

items.title: 美烏矛盾與法國騷亂推升美元！歐元兌多數G10貨幣走貶 今早兌美元一度大跌0.5%
items.title_en: US-Ukraine Tensions and French Unrest Boost the Dollar! Euro Falls Against Most G10 Currencies, Briefly Dropping 0.5% Against the Dollar This Morning
paras: 受美烏矛盾進一步升高及法國大規模抗議活動影響，市場對歐元信心受挫，歐元兌多數G10貨幣在今(19)日亞洲早盤交易時段走低。
周末期間，法國多個城市抗議活動演變為警方與示威者之間的衝突，爆發法國多年來最嚴重的街頭暴力事件，出現搶劫、地標建築遭縱火情況。歐洲多國接連發生示威活動，法國的抗議規模最大，比利時、義大利、葡萄牙也受到波及。與此同時，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基周日(18日)指責川普試圖向基輔施壓，逼迫烏克蘭向俄羅斯投降。
歐元兌美元在今日早盤一度貶值0.5%，最低貶至 1.1183 美元，隨後部分收復跌幅，交投於 1.1212 美元附近。受歐元走弱拖累，東歐貨幣表現弱於其他新興市場貨幣，美元兌波蘭茲羅提升值0.5%，報3.9071；美元兌匈牙利福林走升0.5%，報324.88，美元兌保加利亞列弗亦升值0.5%，報1.7485。
澳洲聯邦銀行外匯策略師Carol Kong表示：「市場恐將持續為歐元計入風險溢價。歐元兌美元本周可能測試 1.1130支撐價位，尤其是在地緣緊張進一步推高美元的情況下。」
paras_en: Rising US‑Ukraine tensions and large‑scale protests in France have dented market confidence in the euro, causing the euro to fall against most G10 currencies during Asian early‑trade on the 19th.

Over the weekend, protests in several French cities escalated into clashes between police and demonstrators, sparking the most severe street violence France has seen in years, including robberies and arson of landmark buildings. Demonstrations spread across multiple European countries, with France seeing the largest protests, and Belgium, Italy and Portugal also affected. At the same time, Ukrainian President Zelensky on Sunday (the 18th) accused former U.S. President Trump of trying to pressure Kyiv into surrendering to Russia.

The euro‑dollar pair slipped as much as 0.5% in early trade today, hitting a low of 1.1183 USD before partially regaining ground and trading around 1.1212 USD. The euro’s weakness also weighed on Eastern European currencies, which underperformed other emerging‑market currencies: the dollar rose 0.5% against the Polish zloty to 3.9071, against the Hungarian forint to 324.88, and against the Bulgarian lev to 1.7485.

Carol Kong, FX strategist at Commonwealth Bank of Australia, said: “The market is likely to continue pricing a risk premium into the euro. The euro‑dollar pair could test the 1.1130 support level this week, especially if geopolitical tensions further lift the dollar.”
